strings.2 号发电机烧黑了的滤芯座: The blackened filter housing from Generator No. 2
strings.6 月 13 日凌晨三点，南极内陆冰盖上的雪岭站，海拔 3050 米。发电机房突: Three in the morning, June 13. Xueling Station, 3,050 meters up on the Antarctic ice sheet. The generator room went up without warning and the fire ran along the connecting corridor into the main building. Outside it was the polar night, past minus sixty, and the flames turned the snowfield red.
strings.6 月 13 日凌晨，极夜: Small hours of June 13, polar night
strings.6 月 21 日，仲冬节——南极每个越冬站一年里最大的节日。往年这一天，杨师傅会: June 21, Midwinter's Day, the biggest holiday of the year at any Antarctic winter-over station. In other years Chef Yang would cook a tableful of food and the stations would wire their greetings back and forth. This year the emergency container had one rattling heater.
strings.{actor} 一个人回来了，什么也没说。: {actor} comes back alone and says nothing.
strings.{actor} 一手抓住刀背，一手推开老马。两个人被拉开了，各自缩回了自己的铺位: {actor} grabs the flat of the blade with one hand and shoves Old Ma back with the other. The two of them are pulled apart and crawl back to their own bunks.
strings.{actor} 一把拉开了何远的睡袋：几块巧克力和能量棒掉了出来。: {actor} rips Evan Ho's sleeping bag open: a few squares of chocolate and some energy bars fall out.
strings.{actor} 一把攥住了他的手腕，刀当啷一声掉在舱板上。姜涛像被抽了骨头一样瘫: {actor} seizes his wrist and the knife clatters onto the floor. Tommy Jiang goes down like a man with the bones pulled out of him, sobbing until he cannot breathe.
strings.{actor} 一行一行地念完了日志。舱里没有人出声，所有人都在看老马和站长。: {actor} reads the log out line by line. Nobody in the container makes a sound. Every eye is on Old Ma and the station chief.
strings.{actor} 什么也没说，只是多看了老马几眼。: {actor} says nothing, only looks at Old Ma a moment longer than the rest.
strings.{actor} 什么也没说，可看站长的眼神变了。: {actor} says nothing, but something in the way {actor.he} looks at the chief has changed.
strings.{actor} 从半夜开始右下腹剧痛、发烧，一阵一阵地吐。天亮时她按了按自己的肚: {actor} wakes in the small hours with a knife of pain low on the right side, fever, waves of vomiting. By dawn she presses her own belly, calm, and says it out loud: "Acute appendicitis." The only person at the station who can operate is her. In April 1961, at Novolazarevskaya Station in Antarctica, the Soviet doctor Rogozov took out his own appendix in front of a mirror.
strings.{actor} 从油料区往回走，扶手绳在一处断了。雪雾贴着地面翻滚，头灯照出去不: Walking back from the fuel depot, {actor} feels the guide rope part in {actor.his} hands. Snow smoke rolls along the ground and the headlamp reaches less than two meters. The emergency container is a hundred meters away — but which way is a hundred meters?
strings.{actor} 低着头，把那个数字说了出来。: {actor} keeps {actor.his} head down and says the number out loud.
strings.{actor} 冲进去没几步就被浓烟顶了回来，双手烫起了一片水疱。: {actor} gets two steps into the smoke before it drives {actor.him} back out, both hands coming up in blisters.
strings.{actor} 冻伤的地方起了水疱，摸上去又硬又凉。懂急救的人都知道：要用 38: {actor}'s frostbite has blistered, hard and cold under the fingers. Anyone with first-aid training knows the drill: soak it open slowly in water at about 38°C. But boiling a big pot of water burns a lot of diesel.
strings.{actor} 半夜爬起来，把所有人的靴子都烘了一遍。: {actor} gets up in the middle of the night and dries everyone's boots by the heater.
strings.{actor} 和何远达成了交易：一块巧克力，换一句“什么也没看见”。: {actor} strikes a deal with Evan Ho: one square of chocolate for one "I didn't see anything."
strings.{actor} 和身边的人小声聊了一整夜，从小时候一直聊到出去以后。: {actor} whispers with the person in the next bunk all night, from childhood all the way to what they will do when they get out.
strings.{actor} 咬咬牙，朝认定的方向走了出去。: {actor} grits {actor.his} teeth and walks off in the direction {actor.he} has chosen.
strings.{actor} 在从机房废墟里拖回来的零件堆里，认出了 2 号发电机烧黑的滤芯座: In the heap of parts dragged back from the generator-room ruins, {actor} recognizes the scorched filter housing from Generator No. 2: the clamp on the fuel return line is hanging loose off its fitting, never tightened at all.
strings.{actor} 在厨房的燃气阀旁边找到了杨师傅。他已经没有了呼吸，一只手还搭在阀: {actor} finds Chef Yang beside the kitchen gas valve. He is not breathing. One hand is still resting on the valve.
strings.{actor} 在门口站了十分钟，直到睫毛结了冰。: {actor} stands in the doorway for ten minutes, until {actor.his} eyelashes freeze.
strings.{actor} 在雪雾里绕了一个多钟头，最后是撞上一根标志杆才摸回来的。: {actor} wanders in the snow smoke for more than an hour and finally finds the way back by walking into a marker pole.
strings.{actor} 张了张嘴，又低下了头：“……是我的错，跟别人没关系。”: {actor} opens {actor.his} mouth, then drops {actor.his} head. "...It was my fault. Nobody else's."
strings.{actor} 想起了家里的人。: {actor} thinks about the people back home.
strings.{actor} 把一氧化碳报警器挂在了暖风机旁边。: {actor} hangs the carbon-monoxide alarm beside the heater.
strings.{actor} 把冻伤的地方裹紧，塞进了睡袋。: {actor} wraps the frostbitten part tight and burrows into {actor.his} sleeping bag.
strings.{actor} 把周宇的话原原本本地转述了一遍。: {actor} repeats Ethan Zhou's words exactly as they were said.
strings.{actor} 把周宇的话悄悄告诉了老马。老马蹲在暖风机后面，一夜没睡。: {actor} quietly tells Old Ma what Ethan Zhou said. Old Ma crouches behind the heater and does not sleep all night.
strings.{actor} 把所有人叫到一起，把报警旁路的事从头到尾说了一遍。: {actor} calls everyone together and tells the whole story of the bypassed alarm, start to finish.
strings.{actor} 把手脚泡进温水里，疼得直冒冷汗，可皮肤的颜色一点点回来了。: {actor} soaks {actor.his} hands and feet in warm water. It hurts enough to bring a cold sweat, but the color creeps back into the skin.
strings.{actor} 把杯子里的酒慢慢倒在雪地上，雪面上冒起了一小股白气。: {actor} pours the liquor out slowly onto the snow. A thin thread of vapor rises off the surface.
strings.{actor} 把止痛片掰成两半，吞了一半，把另一半放回了药箱。: {actor} snaps a painkiller in half, swallows one half, and puts the other back in the kit.
strings.{actor} 把滤芯座塞进了老马的工具包里。: {actor} slips the filter housing into Old Ma's tool bag.
strings.{actor} 把滤芯座往桌上一放，什么也没说。所有人都看向了老马。: {actor} sets the filter housing down on the table and says nothing. Every head turns to Old Ma.
strings.{actor} 把滤芯拆下来揣进怀里捂化了蜡，装回去，暖风机重新喘起了气。: {actor} pulls the filter, thaws the wax out of it against {actor.his} chest, fits it back in — and the heater coughs itself back to life.
strings.{actor} 把自己那一口倒回了壶里，拧紧了盖子。: {actor} tips {actor.his} own mouthful back into the flask and screws the cap down tight.
strings.{actor} 把那块烧黑的铁疙瘩扔进了雪里。: {actor} throws the blackened lump of iron out into the snow.
strings.{actor} 把那天站长怎么吩咐的，一字一句说了出来。: {actor} says, word for word, what the chief ordered that day.
strings.{actor} 把那段日志另存了一份，合上了笔记本。: {actor} saves a copy of that stretch of the log and closes the laptop.
strings.{actor} 抓起一把雪使劲搓——搓破了皮，冻伤反而更重了。: {actor} scoops up a handful of snow and rubs hard — rubs the skin raw, and the frostbite only gets worse.
strings.{actor} 按下了删除键。屏幕的光映在脸上，过了很久才暗下去。: {actor} presses delete. The screen's glow stays on {actor.his} face a long time before it goes dark.
strings.{actor} 沉默了很久，把那天的事说了出来。: {actor} is silent for a long time, then tells what happened that night.
strings.{actor} 灌了一大口，呛得直咳嗽，脸一下子红到了耳根。: {actor} takes one big swallow, coughs half of it back up, face burning red to the ears.
strings.{actor} 用手刨出一个浅浅的雪窝，蜷在里面等风停。: {actor} digs a shallow hollow in the snow with bare hands and curls up in it to wait out the wind.
strings.{actor} 的声音冷了下来。没有人再问。: {actor}'s voice goes cold. Nobody asks again.
strings.{actor} 给周宇掖了掖睡袋：“睡吧，别想了。”: {actor} tucks Ethan Zhou's sleeping bag in around him: "Sleep. Stop thinking."
strings.{actor} 给自己定了闹钟，到点就闭眼，哪怕睡不着。: {actor} sets an alarm, and when it goes off {actor.he} closes {actor.his} eyes, sleeping or not.
strings.{actor} 给自己挂上了吊瓶，输液管从睡袋里穿出来，吊在舱顶的挂钩上。: {actor} hangs an IV for {actor.himself}, the line running out of the sleeping bag up to a hook in the ceiling.
strings.{actor} 翻了个身，假装睡着了。: {actor} rolls over and pretends to be asleep.
strings.{actor} 翻了个身，把睡袋拉过了头顶。: {actor} rolls over and pulls the sleeping bag up over {actor.his} head.
strings.{actor} 背着唐悦回来的时候，两个人的眉毛和睫毛都冻成了白色。: When {actor} carries Yvonne Tang back in, both of them have white eyebrows and white eyelashes.
strings.{actor} 走了不到五分钟，头灯就照到了应急舱的铁门。: Five minutes out, {actor}'s headlamp lands on the steel door of the emergency container.
strings.{actor} 跌跌撞撞地冲了出去，跪在雪里用手刨开了排气管。: {actor} stumbles outside, drops to {actor.his} knees and digs the exhaust pipe clear with bare hands.
strings.{actor} 蹲下来，跟他说起了杨师傅包饺子的样子。: {actor} crouches down beside him and talks about the way Chef Yang used to fold dumplings.
strings.{actor} 蹲在雪里敲了四十分钟的油桶盖，才等来了一束头灯。: {actor} crouches in the snow, hammering on a drum lid for forty minutes, before a headlamp beam finally finds {actor.him}.
strings.{actor} 转身回了舱里，把门摔得震天响。: {actor} turns and goes back inside, slamming the door hard enough to shake the walls.
strings.{actor} 锯了整整四十分钟。巴特尔咬断了一截皮带，一声都没喊。: {actor} saws for a full forty minutes. Baatar bites through a length of strap and never makes a sound.
strings.{leader} 用量油尺量了暖风机的油箱：还剩 {res.diesel}。暖风: {leader} checks the heater's tank with the dipstick: {res.diesel} left. The heater burns 14 L a day. Outside, the drums at the fuel depot are buried under snow taller than a man and frozen solid as lard.
strings.{target} 拉上面罩钻进了风雪里，半个钟头后被拖回来，睫毛上结满了冰。: {target} pulls down {target.his} face mask and walks into the storm. Half an hour later {target.he} is dragged back in, eyelashes crusted with ice.
strings.“My father… Vostok, 1982. Fire.”（他伸出八根手指: "My father… Vostok, 1982. Fire." (He holds up eight fingers, then mimes a ball of flame.)
strings.“Водки нет. Спирт есть.”（伏特加没有。酒精有。）: "Водки нет. Спирт есть." (No vodka. Spirit, yes.)
strings.“Минус шестьдесят — нормально. Восток —: "Минус шестьдесят — нормально. Восток — минус восемьдесят." (Minus sixty? Normal. Vostok, minus eighty.)
strings.“Собаки? Нет. Девяносто четвёртый год —: "Собаки? Нет. Девяносто четвёртый год — всё." (Dogs? No. By '94 they were all gone.)
strings.“云底比看上去高，能见度还行。”{actor} 说得很肯定。: "The cloud base is higher than it looks. Visibility's all right." {actor} says it with certainty.
strings.“云高不到一百米，能见度时好时坏，不建议起飞。”{actor} 放下话筒，没敢看: "Cloud ceiling under a hundred meters, visibility coming and going. I can't recommend a flight." {actor} sets down the handset and does not dare look at anyone.
strings.“俺今天去冷库，又看见师父那条围裙了，挂在钩子上，冻得硬邦邦的。”: "I went to the freezer today. Saw Master's apron again, hanging on its hook, frozen stiff."
strings.“俺师父说，人冻透了，一碗热汤顶一件棉袄。”: "My master used to say: when a man's chilled through, a bowl of hot soup is worth a padded coat."
strings.“俺睡不着。一闭眼，就是厨房那扇门。”: "I can't sleep. I close my eyes and it's that kitchen door, every time."
strings.“冷库最里头还有一箱饺子，是师父出事那天下午包的。俺舍不得拿出来。”: "There's still a crate of dumplings at the back of the freezer. Master made them the afternoon of the fire. I can't bring myself to take them out."
strings.“别为了我出去冒险，听见没有？腾格里在上头看着呢。”: "Don't go out and risk your neck for me, you hear? Tengger is watching from up there."
strings.“只要不感染，他就能挺过去。”{actor} 说得斩钉截铁。: "As long as infection doesn't set in, he'll pull through." {actor} says it flat, like a verdict.
strings.“吃了没，老师？锅里还有，俺再给您盛点。”: "Have you eaten yet? There's plenty left in the pot — here, let me get you some more."
strings.“咱们草原上冬天接羔子，羊羔冻僵了就揣进怀里——人也一样，挤一挤就暖和了。”: "On the grassland, when a lamb comes out frozen stiff in winter we tuck it inside our coats. People are the same. Crowd together and you get warm."
strings.“喂？喂——”话还没说完，屏幕就黑了，再也没亮起来。: "Hello? Hello—" The screen goes black mid-word and never lights up again.
strings.“她当时各项指标都正常。极夜会改变一个人。”{actor} 说得很平静。: "Every reading she gave us was normal. The polar night changes a person." {actor} says it calmly.
strings.“我们撑不了多久了，越快越好！”那头说：“我们会尽力。可天气不由人。”: "We can't hold out much longer. The sooner the better!" The voice on the other end says, "We'll do everything we can. But the weather doesn't answer to us.""
strings.“我们还有暖风机，还有吃的，别让飞行员冒险。”说完这句话，舱里有人偷偷抹了一下眼: "We still have the heater. We still have food. Don't send pilots out to die." When the words are out, someone in the container quietly wipes an eye.
strings.“我妈还以为我在南极看企鹅……内陆哪有企鹅嘛。”: "My mom still thinks I'm down here looking at penguins... There aren't any penguins inland."
strings.“昨晚俺听见师父在外面敲门……你们没听见？”: "Last night I heard Master knocking outside... Didn't you hear it?"
strings.“没事儿，脚冻了还有嘴。来，我给你们讲讲草原上的白毛风。”: "It's fine. Feet are gone but the mouth still works. Come on, I'll tell you about the white wind on the grassland."
strings.“油没了就去挖，人冻坏了就什么都没了。”这句话说完，没人再反对。: "Run out of fuel and we dig for more. Freeze a man and we've got nothing left." After that, nobody argues.
strings.“现在追究这个有什么用？先想办法让她撑下去。”: "What good does picking at it now do? First we keep her alive."
strings.“脚趾头黑了？黑了好，黑了就不疼了。”: "Toes gone black? Good. Black means they stopped hurting."
strings.“苏医生，你歇一哈嘛，我又不得跑。”: "Doctor Su, take a rest. I'm not going anywhere."
strings.“药怎么用，我是医生，我说了算。”: "How the drugs get used — I'm the doctor. That's my call."
strings.“莫得事，莫得事……就是有点痒。”: "It's nothing, it's nothing... just a little itchy."
strings.“莫给我盖那么多，我身上烧得慌。”: "Don't pile so much on me. I'm burning up."
strings.“评估的时候她一切正常。”: "On her evaluation she was fine. Completely normal."
strings.“这副碗筷别动，是给师父留的。”: "Don't touch that bowl and those chopsticks. They're set out for Master."
strings.“那个阀门……我关上了吧？关上了就好。”: "That valve... I did close it, didn't I? Good. That's good."
strings.“那是他的命。”有人说，“再找找别的电池。”: "That's his fate," someone says. "Look for other batteries."
strings.“马哥，等回去了，我请你到锡林郭勒喝奶茶，喝到你走不动道。”: "Brother Ma — when we get out of here I'm taking you to Xilingol for milk tea. I'll drink you till you can't walk."
strings.“马师傅，等我好了，那台 2 号机我来修。”: "Master Ma, when I'm better, I'll fix No. 2 myself."
strings.一个人系上安全绳，沿着脚印追了出去。: One of them ropes up and follows the tracks out into the dark.
strings.一个漏了一半的油桶，桶底结着一层蜡: A fuel drum, half emptied, a layer of wax frozen across the bottom
strings.一卷还能用的同轴电缆: A coil of coaxial cable, still good
strings.一口下去从喉咙烧到胃，浑身发热——其实是皮肤的血管被酒精撑开了，热散得更快: It burns from throat to stomach and floods the whole body with heat — which is really the blood vessels of the skin opening wide and letting the heat out faster
strings.一台没烧坏的天线调谐器: An antenna tuner that survived the fire
strings.一整桶还没开封的南极柴油: A full, unopened drum of Antarctic diesel
strings.一桶低凝点的南极专用柴油: A drum of Antarctic-grade diesel with a low pour point
strings.一桶柴油、一箱吃的、一箱俄国药——另一桶油是他回程要烧的，他歇几天就得走: A drum of diesel, a crate of food, a crate of Russian medicine — the other drum is his fuel home, and after a few days' rest he has to go
strings.一氧化碳：吹雪会把暖风机的排气管埋住，废气倒灌进密闭的舱里。积雪越多、暖风机烧得: Carbon monoxide: blowing snow buries the heater's exhaust pipe and the fumes back up into a sealed container. The deeper the drift and the longer the heater runs, the worse the risk at night — this is a real killer in polar huts and tents.
strings.一点药都不花；运气不好，阑尾会穿孔: Costs no medicine at all; with bad luck the appendix ruptures
strings.一盒备用的燃油滤芯: A box of spare fuel filters
strings.一箱跑道用的燃烧罐: A crate of runway flare pots
strings.一股暖空气翻上了冰盖，气温一下子回升了十几度，风也停了——冬天里少有的飞行窗口。: A tongue of warm air rolls up over the ice sheet. The temperature climbs ten-odd degrees and the wind dies — a flying window, rare in winter.
strings.三个人把他按在铺位上。针扎下去以后，他一直看着{leader}，直到眼睛慢慢闭上: Three of them hold him down on his bunk. After the needle goes in he keeps his eyes on {leader} until they slowly close.
strings.三年的观测数据后来发在了国际期刊上，致谢只有一行：“献给雪岭站的越冬队员。”他没: Three years of observations were published in an international journal not long after. The acknowledgments ran to one line: "For the winter-over crew of Xueling Station." He never wrote down why he was a few minutes late calling out that night. Every time someone praised that dataset, he changed the subject.
strings.三百公里极夜里的冰原：走到了，有暖气、医生和电台；车要是在半路趴了窝……: Three hundred kilometers of ice in the polar night. Get there and there is heat, a doctor, a radio. If the vehicle dies halfway...
strings.上个月发电机房的烟感探头三天两头误报，半夜把全站吵醒了好几回。是你拍板让老马把那: All last month the smoke detector in the generator room kept false-alarming and waking the whole station in the middle of the night. You were the one who decided Old Ma should bypass that fire-alarm circuit: "We'll hook it back up when the new sensor comes in the spring." The night the fire started, nothing rang.
strings.下午，风真的小了，云层裂开了一道缝，气温开始往上走。: By afternoon the wind really does drop. A seam opens in the clouds and the temperature starts to climb.
strings.不动存粮，只给杨师傅敬一杯热水: Leave the stores alone; just raise a cup of hot water to Chef Yang
strings.不喝，我那份留着给伤员消毒: None for me. Save my share to disinfect the wounded.
strings.不瞒也不杀，把麻烦留到以后: Neither hide it nor kill it — leave the problem for later
strings.不给外面添乱，救援会按部就班地准备: Don't add to the chaos out there; the rescue will come together in its own time
strings.不能拆，再想别的办法: Can't take it apart. Find another way.
strings.不花油，但隔这么远很难被看见: Burns no fuel, but at that distance it will be hard to spot
strings.不行，为了几根冰柱子拿命去换，不值: No. Trading lives for a few ice cores isn't worth it
strings.不行，舱顶不能开洞: No. We are not cutting a hole in the roof.
strings.东北口音，嗓门大，爱说“听我的”“这事儿没商量”“都给我精神点”。: Northeastern accent, big voice, fond of saying "Listen to me," "This isn't up for discussion," "Everybody sharpen up."
strings.东方站有医生、有暖气；可三百公里的颠簸，周宇未必扛得到: Vostok has a doctor and heat. But three hundred kilometers of jolting — Ethan Zhou may not last the trip
strings.东方站有医生、有暖气；可三百公里的颠簸，重伤员未必扛得住: Vostok has a doctor and heat. But three hundred kilometers of jolting — a badly hurt man may not last the trip
strings.东方站的医生也许保得住他的脚；路上再冻一回，就说不准了: The doctor at Vostok might save his feet. One more freezing on the road, and who knows
strings.两个人举着头灯和一面小镜子，一个人负责递器械。{actor} 给自己打了局麻，在: Two people hold the headlamp and a small mirror; a third passes the instruments. {actor} gives {actor.himself} a local and makes the first cut into {actor.his} own belly.
strings.两个人吵到嗓子都哑了。那天没有人再提挖油桶的事。: The two of them argue until their voices give out. Nobody mentions digging for fuel drums again that day.
strings.两个人把她按在铺位上，用尼龙绳捆住了手腕。她哭了很久。: Two of them hold her down on her bunk and tie her wrists with nylon cord. She cries for a long time.
strings.两个人拖着雪橇，跟着唐悦钻进了主楼的废墟。: Two of them drag a sledge after Yvonne Tang into the ruins of the main building.
strings.两个人拴着安全绳出发了，头灯的光点越来越小。: Two of them rope up and set out, their headlamp dots shrinking into the dark.
strings.两个人比划了一个钟头，最后在烟囱顶上加了一个防倒灌的风帽。谢尔盖竖起大拇指：“Х: The two of them gesture at each other for an hour and end up fitting a draft cap on the chimney. Sergey puts up his thumb: "Хорошо!"
strings.两个钟头后，舱门被推开了。唐悦自己摸了回来，倒在门口。: Two hours later the door is pushed open. Yvonne Tang has found her own way back, and she collapses in the doorway.
strings.为了今天谁该出去挖油桶，马建军和何远吵了起来。马建军一把揪住何远的衣领，何远顺手: Jason Ma and Evan Ho start fighting over who goes out to dig for fuel today. Jason Ma grabs Evan Ho by the collar; Evan Ho snatches up the knife they cut cans with. The container goes quiet.
strings.主楼东头的冷库、储藏室和医务室没有全烧光。在烧焦的房梁底下刨吃的、药和衣服——冻: The freezer, the storeroom and the infirmary at the east end of the main building did not burn through. Dig food, medicine and clothing out from under the charred beams — the frozen wreckage can come down at any moment.
strings.主楼东头的冷库塌了一半，可里面冻着够吃一冬的肉、菜和速冻饺子。要从塌下来的顶板底: Half the freezer at the east end has collapsed, but inside there is meat, vegetables and frozen dumplings enough for a winter. The crates have to be dragged out one at a time from under the fallen ceiling panels, frozen hard as stone. Heavy work, and the freezer could come down the rest of the way at any moment.
strings.主楼旁的两根天线杆还立着，可天线被烧断了。要在零下六十多度里爬上杆子，重新拉一条: The two antenna masts beside the main building are still standing, but the antenna itself burned through. Someone has to climb a mast at minus sixty and string a new dipole, tens of meters of it.
strings.乐天、嗓门大、爱唱爱闹，疼得直冒冷汗也要先讲个笑话；最怕别人为他冒险，更怕自己成: Cheerful, loud, always singing or clowning; even with a cold sweat of pain on his face he has to get the joke out first. He dreads anyone taking a risk for him, and dreads worse being a burden. He and Jason Ma have been drinking together for years. The black creeps higher up his feet every day; he says nothing, but at night he secretly lifts the sleeping bag to look.
strings.九名越冬队员逃出来八个。炊事员杨师傅回去关燃气阀，没能出来；电工周宇一个人冲进机: Eight of the nine winter-over crew got out. Chef Yang went back to shut off the gas valve and never came out. Ethan Zhou the electrician ran into the generator room alone to throw the main breaker and was burned badly. Baatar the driver felt his way to the fuel depot to close the main fuel valve, lost himself in the blowing snow, and when they found him both feet were frozen like wood. The rest took shelter in the emergency container a hundred and fifty meters from the main building — an insulated shipping container with a diesel heater.
strings.九月底，第一架补给飞机落在雪岭站。飞行员看见了烧成空壳的主楼，还有不远处一个被雪: At the end of September the first supply plane landed at Xueling Station. The pilot saw the main building burned down to a shell, and not far off, a shipping container half buried in snow. The heater's tank had been dry for a long time. The people inside were pressed together as if asleep. Nobody will ever know what they said to each other in those last days.
strings.也许他还活着；也可能把找他的人也搭进火场: Maybe he's still alive; or maybe whoever goes looking just feeds another body to the fire
strings.也许真是胡话: Maybe it really is the delirium talking
strings.也许能快一些；也等于逼着飞行员冒险: It might be faster; it also means pushing the pilots into a risk they didn't choose
strings.云压得很低，看不见星星，头灯照出去是一片灰白。: The clouds sit low, no stars, and a headlamp shows nothing but flat gray
strings.人多找得全；所有人都要在冰原上冻一个多钟头: More searchers cover more ground; everyone spends an hour and more freezing out on the ice
strings.人都这样了，追究还有什么用: He's like this already. What good would laying blame do now
strings.什么都不消耗——等于承认他撑不过去: Costs nothing — and admits he isn't going to make it
strings.什么都不消耗；体温最低的人最危险: Costs nothing; whoever is coldest is in the most danger
strings.什么都不花——等于把他交给运气: Costs nothing — and leaves him to luck
strings.今晚，南极每个越冬站都守在电台旁边: Tonight every winter-over station in Antarctica is sitting beside its radio
strings.从上风处的雪坑里切几块干净的雪砖搬进来化开。暖风机开着的时候，把雪锅架在出风口上: Cut clean snow blocks from a drift upwind and carry them in to melt. With the heater running, a pot of snow set on the vent melts for free. With the heater off it takes the snow stove, and one pot costs 1.5 L of diesel. With no fuel at all, snow goes into bottles and gets thawed inside someone's coat — which doesn't yield much.
strings.从冷库搬冻肉: Haul frozen meat out of the freezer
strings.从机房废墟里翻出来的那盒滤芯，正好派上用场: The box of filters dug out of the generator-room ruins turns out to be exactly what is needed
strings.从油料点拖回来的那部旧铱星电话躺在桌上，电池冻得冰凉。在零下六十度，锂电池几分钟: The old Iridium phone dragged back from the fuel cache lies on the table, its battery cold as iron. At minus sixty a lithium battery dumps its whole charge in minutes — they have to find a way to keep it alive long enough to connect.
strings.从烧变形的机柜里拆出电源模块和几个接头: Strip a power module and a few connectors out of a warped equipment rack
strings.从那天起，饭桌上一直多摆着一副碗筷，谁也没去碰它。: From that day on there was always an extra bowl and a pair of chopsticks set out at the table, and nobody ever touched them.
strings.他一个人走得快，也最安全；舱里少一张嘴，也少了一双最能干的手: Alone he travels fast, and safest; the container loses one mouth to feed and also its most capable pair of hands
strings.他们把杨师傅裹在一个睡袋里，安放在应急舱旁边的雪里，插了一根标志杆。: They wrap Chef Yang in a sleeping bag, lay him in the snow beside the emergency container, and plant a marker pole over him.
strings.他们跟着谢尔盖的车灯，在零下六十多度的极夜里走了三百公里。东方站的人拉开雪橇屋的: They followed Sergey's tail lights three hundred kilometers through the polar night at minus sixty. When the men at Vostok pulled open the door of the sledge cabin, the people inside could no longer speak. Those who made it: {survivors}. Those who did not: {dead} — some left at Xueling Station, some left on the way. Sergey planted a marker pole at every one of them, for the summer convoy.
strings.他右脚的前掌没保住。第二年夏天，他穿着一只特制的靴子回到锡林郭勒，在那达慕的会场: He lost the front of his right foot. The next summer he went back to Xilingol in a custom boot and watched his son race horses at the edge of the Naadam grounds. He would never drive a snow tractor again, so he taught at the banner driving school, and every student's first lesson was: where is the main fuel valve, and which way do you turn it.
strings.他回到东方站那天，站长骂了他半个钟头，然后给他倒了一杯酒。第二年夏天，中国的考察: The day he got back to Vostok the chief cursed him out for half an hour, then poured him a drink. The next summer the Chinese research ship brought Vostok a crate of tea and a letter, written in Russian typed out in pinyin, more than half of it wrong. He nailed the letter to the wall of the machine shop, next to the old photograph of his father.
strings.他在东方站的医务室里躺到了十一月。俄国医生每天给他换药，谢尔盖每天来念一页俄文报: He lay in the infirmary at Vostok until November. The Russian doctor changed his dressings every day and Sergey came every day to read a page of a Russian newspaper aloud; neither understood the other, but he waited for it every day. Back home he had nine skin grafts, and a postcard of Vostok stayed taped behind his dormitory door.
strings.他在烟台开了一家小面馆，招牌上写着“杨记”。他每个月去看一次心理医生，从不缺席。: He opened a little noodle shop in Yantai with a sign that reads Yang's. He sees a therapist once a month and has never missed an appointment. Every June 13 the shop stays shut, and he spends the whole day in the back making dumplings, then delivers them door to door around the neighborhood.
strings.他在说胡话，别当真: He's delirious. Don't take it to heart
strings.他多半会把日志公之于众: He will most likely make the log public
strings.他把周宇的工具包带回了家，摆在自己的工具箱旁边，一直没打开过。那个卡箍的事他对谁: He took Ethan Zhou's tool bag home and set it beside his own toolbox and never opened it. He told no one about the clamp. He never touched a generator again; he switched to long-haul trucking and took the night routes on purpose.
strings.他留下的最后一份气象记录写在一块硬纸板上：日期、气压、风速、云量，字迹工工整整。: The last weather record he left was written on a piece of cardboard: date, pressure, wind speed, cloud cover, the letters neat and square. The cardboard was later framed and hung in the weather room of the rebuilt Xueling Station.
strings.他的名字在事故调查报告里出现了两次：一次在“遇难人员”一栏，一次在“责任认定”一: His name appears twice in the accident report: once in the column for the dead, once in the column for responsibility. His wife read the report through, folded that page, and put it under his funeral portrait.
strings.他的多功能工具钳被带回了河北。他儿子后来也当了机械师，那把钳子一直别在腰带上，钳: His multitool went home to Hebei. His son became a mechanic too and wore the tool on his belt; there is still a scorch mark on the jaws.
strings.他的狐皮帽子和蒙古刀被带回了锡林郭勒。他父亲把帽子挂在蒙古包的哈那墙上，每年春天: His fox-fur hat and his Mongolian knife went back to Xilingol. His father hung the hat on the wall of the yurt and said a few words to it every spring when the lambs came. Xueling Station later put up a wooden board at the door of the pump house in the fuel depot, with his name on it.
strings.他的笔记本电脑被带回了国内，数据由同事整理发表，第一作者一栏写着他的名字。没有人: His laptop went home. His colleagues organized and published the data with his name in the first-author line. Nobody knows that what he ran back to the dormitory for that night, before he shouted for anyone, was the laptop.
strings.他的遗物里有一个记满电路图的本子，最后几页的字歪歪扭扭，画的是 2 号发电机的线: Among his things was a notebook full of circuit diagrams, the last pages scrawled crookedly with the wiring of Generator No. 2. The notebook went to his mother. Every winter for years she mailed a crate of Sichuan cured pork to the polar research center.
strings.他的雪地车在雪岭站停了一整个冬天。第二年夏天，东方站的车队把它开了回去，驾驶室的: His snow tractor sat at Xueling Station all winter. The next summer the Vostok convoy drove it home; tucked behind the sun visor was a black-and-white photograph: Vostok, 1982, a group of soot-faced men standing in front of a burned-out power station, laughing.
strings.他突然把刀转向了自己的手腕。等大家扑上去，血已经流了一地。: He turns the knife on his own wrist. By the time they get to him there is blood all over the floor.
strings.他跟着雪岭站的人一起离开了冰盖。后来每年 6 月 21 日仲冬节，雪岭站的电台都: He left the ice sheet with the Xueling crew. Afterwards, every June 21, Midwinter's Day, the station radio would call Vostok, and the first words were always the same: "Sergey, Ничего?" And the answer always came back: "Нормально."
strings.他那只吹了二十年的铜哨子被带回了哈尔滨，后来挂在极地中心越冬队员培训室的墙上。新: The brass whistle he had blown for twenty years went home to Harbin and was hung on the wall of the winter-over training room at the polar center. When new crew ask about it, the instructor says one sentence: "The night of the fire, he was the one who woke everybody."
strings.以后每天要多耗掉一份口粮，可他心里会好受一点: Costs one extra ration a day from now on, but it will ease something in him
strings.会冻得很厉害，但不会走丢: He'll freeze hard, but he won't get lost
strings.何远把 {actor} 叫到舱门外的风里，压低了声音：“报警旁路的事，日志我都看: Evan Ho calls {actor} out into the wind at the door and drops his voice: "I've read the log. I know about the bypass. From here on I make the calls — and this stays buried in me."
strings.何远拿着纸箱板，跟谢尔盖一个单词一个单词地对。: Evan Ho holds up the cardboard and goes through it with Sergey, one word at a time.
strings.何远看着自己的笔记本被拆开，一句话也没说。电话的屏幕亮了。: Evan Ho watches his laptop come apart and says nothing. The phone screen lights up.
strings.何远说的“stop”，谢尔盖听成了“stove”。等大家反应过来，他已经把暖风机: Evan Ho said "stop"; Sergey heard "stove." By the time anyone worked out what had happened, he had pulled the heater's duct off and hooked it to the stove — and that night the container was cold as a freezer.
strings.何远那点英语是舱里唯一的翻译——可他也只会几十个词: Evan Ho's few words of English are the only translation in the container — and he only has a few dozen of them
strings.你吃饱一点，他欠你一个秘密: Fill up. He'll owe you a secret.
strings.你清点过药箱：抗生素只够一个人用一个疗程。周宇的烧伤超过体表三分之一，还吸进了烟: You have counted the medicine: there is one course of antibiotics, enough for one person. Ethan Zhou's burns cover more than a third of his body and he breathed in smoke; without a burn unit, your experience says he will not last until the plane comes — and yet you have told everyone "he'll pull through." Who the drugs should be saved for, you have not decided.
strings.你的秘密会被揭开，大家会开始算账: Your secret will come out, and people will start settling accounts
strings.保住眼前的一切；主楼里剩下的东西，就看火给不给留了: Save what is in front of you; what is left in the main building depends on what the fire decided to leave
strings.保住秘密，丢掉位置: Keep the secret, lose the position
strings.保住秘密，活着回去: Keep the secret, get home alive
strings.保鲜膜干净、不粘伤口，是真实的烧伤急救办法；效果差一点，但不费药: Cling film is clean and doesn't stick to a wound — a real field dressing for burns. It works a little worse, but it costs no supplies
strings.修得好就没事；修不好，所有人要冻一整夜: Fix it and everything is fine; fail and everyone freezes all night
strings.修电台的进度大增；何远三年的数据就没了: The radio comes together fast; Evan Ho's three years of data are gone
strings.倒一点在雪里，敬杨师傅: Pour a little out on the snow for Chef Yang
strings.倔、乐观、怕给人添麻烦；疼得厉害时会咬着毛巾不出声。: Stubborn, cheerful, hates being a bother; when the pain is bad he bites down on a towel and makes no sound.
strings.储藏室里几箱烤变了形的罐头和压缩饼干: A few crates of heat-warped cans and hardtack from the storeroom
strings.像罗戈佐夫那样，给自己开刀: Do what Rogozov did: operate on yourself
strings.先不声张，私下找站长谈谈: Keep it quiet for now, talk to the chief in private
strings.先不说，回去以后跟调查组说: Say nothing now, tell the inquiry board when you get home
strings.先把暖风机关掉，等毒气散了再说: Shut the heater down first and let the gas clear
strings.先挤在一起熬到天亮再修: Huddle together until daylight, then fix it
strings.先是一阵沙沙的杂音，然后是一个疲惫的声音：“……雪岭站，雪岭站，这里是海岸站，听: First a hiss of static, then a tired voice: "...Xueling, Xueling, this is Coast Station, come in..." For the first time since the fire, the outside world has heard you. Coast Station wants a full report.
strings.先让何远用英语跟他问清楚: Have Evan Ho ask him in English first
strings.八十公斤的冰芯。机长会骂人，但也许会点头: Eighty kg of ice cores. The pilot will swear, but he might say yes
strings.公平，但他的身体会一天天耗下去: Fair, but his body will burn down day by day
strings.其他人少挨冻；可两个人未必能全部找回来: The others stay out of the cold; but two people may not be able to bring it all back
strings.其他人留在舱里；一个人找，把握小一些: The others stay in the container; one searcher has worse odds
strings.内蒙古口音，爱说“没事儿，腾格里保佑”“咱们草原上……”，疼急了会用蒙语骂一句。: Inner Mongolian accent, fond of saying "It's fine, Tengger will provide" and "Out on the grassland..."; when the pain spikes he swears once in Mongolian.
strings.内蒙古锡林郭勒牧民的儿子，第三次越冬，管全站的雪地车和几十吨柴油。火灾那晚，他一: Son of a herder from Xilingol in Inner Mongolia, third winter-over, responsible for the station's snow tractors and its tens of tons of diesel. The night of the fire he felt his way alone to the fuel depot to close the main fuel valve — if the fire had run down the fuel line, the whole depot would have gone up. He closed the valve and then lost himself in the blowing snow, and curled up in the pump house for five hours before they found him. Both feet frozen like wood; he cannot take a step.
strings.冰盖上一片平坦，没有山、没有树，只有一串插着小旗的标志杆，把主楼、油料区、车库和: The ice sheet runs flat in every direction — no hills, no trees, only a line of marker poles with little flags on them, linking the main building, the fuel depot, the garage and a runway six kilometers out. The sun will not rise again until August.
strings.冰盖冬季的真实气象：晴朗无风的夜里最冷（−70°C 上下），起风、转阴反而“暖”: What winter on the ice sheet is really like: the coldest nights are clear and windless, around −70°C; when the wind gets up or the sky clouds over, it turns several degrees "warmer" — the wind stirs out the inversion layer hugging the ground. Now and then warm air spills over the ice sheet and the temperature climbs ten-odd degrees in a day, and that is the only weather window winter flying ever gets.
strings.冰芯在实验室的冷库里躺了一年，她的博士论文用的就是那几箱。答辩时有个评委问冰芯是: The ice cores sat in a lab freezer for a year; her dissertation was built on those crates. At her defense a committee member asked how the cores had been saved. She thought about it a long time and said, "Everyone helped me get them out." Then she could not say anything else.
strings.冰芯留在了冰盖上。她用剩下的一年写完了论文，题目改了三次。毕业那天她剪了短发，去: The ice cores stayed on the ice sheet. She used the year that was left to finish the dissertation, and changed the title three times. The day she graduated she cut her hair short and went to work for a polar equipment company, testing the insulation of emergency containers.
strings.冰芯箱一个一个被拖了出来，埋进了应急舱外的雪坑里。唐悦跪在雪坑边，很久都没站起来: The ice-core crates were dragged out one at a time and buried in a snow pit outside the emergency container. Yvonne Tang knelt at the edge of the pit and did not stand up for a long time.
strings.冰芯箱被拖出来，埋进了应急舱外的雪坑里冻着。唐悦抱着箱子哭了很久。: The ice-core crates were dragged out and buried in a snow pit outside the container to keep frozen. Yvonne Tang held one and cried for a long time.
strings.冲上去把两个人拉开: Jump in and pull the two of them apart
strings.冷库的顶塌下来一角，{actor} 被砸在了下面。冰芯没能拖出来。: A corner of the freezer ceiling came down and {actor} was caught under it. The ice cores never came out.
strings.冷库角落里码着唐悦的冰芯样品箱——居然完好无损: Stacked in the corner of the freezer are Yvonne Tang's ice-core crates — somehow untouched
strings.冷库里还能拖出来的食物（箱）。: Food still recoverable from the freezer (crates).
strings.冷库门口散落的几箱冻牛肉和速冻饺子: A few crates of frozen beef and dumplings scattered by the freezer door
strings.冷库顶板砸伤: Crushed by a falling freezer ceiling panel
strings.冷静、专业、有分寸；心软，看不得病人受罪；习惯一个人扛下决定，不太跟人商量；被质: Calm, professional, measured; soft-hearted, unable to watch a patient suffer; used to carrying decisions alone and not much given to consulting anyone; turns cold when her judgment is questioned.
strings.冻黑的脚趾最后还是截掉了三个。他又报名了下一次越冬，体检没过，在通知书上用蒙语骂: Three blackened toes came off in the end. He signed up for the next winter-over and failed the physical, and swore once in Mongolian on the letter. That winter he planted a row of little flags from his door out to the sheep pen, so that walking out at night he would not get lost.
strings.凌晨四点，守夜的人发现姜涛站在{leader}的铺位前，手里攥着一把烧没了刀把的: At four in the morning the watch finds Tommy Jiang standing over {leader}'s bunk, gripping a cleaver with the handle burned away — Chef Yang's cleaver. He has not slept in days, and he keeps saying it over and over: "Master is still in there... Why did you stop me..."
strings.凌晨，有人被灌进来的冷风冻醒：舱门虚掩着，唐悦的铺位空了。门外的雪地上有一串脚印: Before dawn someone wakes to cold air pouring in: the door is ajar and Yvonne Tang's bunk is empty. A line of footprints leads out from the door into the dark, away from the flag line. She was wearing only a down jacket.
strings.几个人冲进主楼东头的浓烟里，抱着能抓到的一切跑了回来。: Several of them run into the smoke at the east end of the main building and come back with whatever their arms can hold.
strings.几个人抱着冰芯箱跑到了机长面前。: Several of them carry the ice-core crates up to the pilot.
strings.几个搪瓷缸碰在一起，热气在头灯的光里升起来。没有人说话。: Enamel mugs knock together and steam rises through the headlamp beams. Nobody says anything.
strings.几乎一定能接通——何远三年的数据就没了: Nearly certain to connect — and Evan Ho's three years of data are gone
strings.出去把暖风机排气管和舱门口的积雪清掉、把门缝重新封好。不费什么力气，可排气管堵着: Go out and clear the snow off the heater's exhaust and away from the door, and seal the door gaps again. It costs almost no strength, but with the exhaust blocked the fumes back up into the container.
strings.出去看一会儿: Go out and take a look for a while
strings.出发前的越冬心理评估，你其实没有通过——你有抑郁症病史。是你哭着求苏医生，她心一: You did not actually pass the psychological evaluation before deployment — you have a history of depression. You begged Doctor Su, and she went soft and changed the conclusion and signed it. Your medication burned in the fire. These last days you keep feeling the walls press inward, and more than once you have wanted to push the door open and step outside for air — even at minus sixty.
strings.刀划开了 {actor} 的袖子和胳膊。血溅在舱壁上，很快冻成了黑红色的冰点。: The knife opens {actor}'s sleeve and arm. Blood spatters the wall and freezes almost at once into dark red beads.
strings.刀被收进了工具箱，钥匙挂在了领头人的脖子上。: The knife goes back in the toolbox and the key goes around the leader's neck.
strings.删掉这段日志: Delete that section of the log
strings.别吓着他，慢慢跟他说话: Don't spook him. Talk to him slowly.
strings.包裹全找回来了：药品、食物、一桶伞降的柴油，还有一部带着备用电池的铱星电话。: All the bundles came back: medicine, food, a drum of diesel dropped by parachute, and an Iridium phone with a spare battery.
strings.医务室里烧剩的半箱烧伤敷料: Half a box of burn dressings left in the infirmary
strings.医用酒精，本来就是干这个的: Medical alcohol. This is what it is for.
strings.医疗后送的优先级最高，救援会准备得更快——但苏敏得在电台里说出周宇真实的伤情: A medical evacuation gets top priority and the rescue will move faster — but Monica Su has to say Ethan Zhou's real condition over the radio
strings.半夜，{actor} 闻到一股巧克力的甜味，是从何远的睡袋那边飘过来的。: In the middle of the night {actor} smells chocolate, sweet, drifting over from Evan Ho's sleeping bag.
strings.半夜，守在门口的人突然喊了起来：头顶有发动机的声音，很高、很远，一个闪着红灯的小: In the middle of the night whoever is on the door suddenly shouts: there is an engine overhead, high and far, a little red-blinking point crawling across the stars — someone out there has finally sent a plane for them!
strings.半夜，暖风机咳嗽了几声，停了。舱里一下子安静得可怕——油路里的柴油析出了蜡，滤芯: In the middle of the night the heater coughs a few times and stops. The silence in the container is terrible — the diesel in the fuel line has waxed out and plugged the filter solid. The temperature starts dropping, degree by degree.
strings.半夜，舱外传来柴油机的轰鸣。两道车灯从黑暗里摇摇晃晃地开过来——一台插着俄罗斯国: In the middle of the night a diesel engine growls outside. Two headlights come swaying out of the dark — a snow tractor flying a Russian flag, towing a smoking sledge cabin. A big man crusted with ice jumps down, bellows something in Russian, then forces out English one word at a time: "Vostok... three hundred kilometers... You... alive?"
strings.半桶航空煤油，暖风机也能烧: Half a drum of jet fuel; the heater will burn that too
strings.南方口音，语速快，爱报数据：“气压在掉”“风速每秒十二米”。: Southern accent, fast talker, always reporting numbers: "Pressure's dropping." "Wind at twelve meters a second."
strings.南极内陆冰盖 · 雪岭站（虚构）: Antarctic interior ice sheet · Xueling Station (fictional)
strings.南极科考站越冬: Winter-over at an Antarctic research station
strings.压着的火迟早要出来: What is held down has to come out sooner or later
strings.原地蹲下，敲东西发信号，等人来找: Sit down where you are, bang on something to signal, wait to be found
strings.原型与真实细节：① 1914 年沙克尔顿率“坚忍号”出发横穿南极，船在威德尔海被: Sources and true details: (1) In 1914 Shackleton set out with Endurance to cross Antarctica; the ship was trapped in the Weddell Sea pack, crushed and sank. The 28 men camped on the ice, rowed small boats to barren Elephant Island, and were all rescued by August 1916, nearly two years after they set out — still the classic case study in polar leadership. (2) Before dawn on February 25, 2012, the generator room of Brazil's Comandante Ferraz Antarctic Station caught fire; it spread and destroyed the main building, and two navy sailors died fighting it. In Antarctica fire is the worst accident there is: the water is frozen and the nearest fire brigade is thousands of kilometers away. (3) Psychological crisis in winter-over crews is real: months of polar night, isolation and small-group conflict bring insomnia, depression and "winter-over syndrome," and there have been winter-over crew who attacked people with knives at their own stations. (4) Winter temperatures on the Antarctic plateau are often below −60°C, and aircraft normally cannot land in winter; history holds only a handful of winter rescues — the US Air Force airdropped medicine to the South Pole in July 1999, and in June 2016 two Twin Otters flew to the Pole through the polar night to bring a patient out. (5) In April 1982 the power station at the Soviet Vostok Station burned to the ground and one man died; the survivors converted gas cylinders into diesel stoves and held out through the −70s and −80s of the polar night until summer came. In April 1961 the only doctor at Novolazarevskaya Station, Rogozov, came down with acute appendicitis and operated on himself in front of a mirror. (6) Under the environmental protocol of the Antarctic Treaty, the last sled dogs were taken out of Antarctica by April 1994, and no outside animal has been allowed in since.
strings.去废墟翻东西的人回来说：在厨房塌下来的屋顶底下，看见了杨师傅的那件白色工作服。: The people who went digging in the ruins come back and say: under the collapsed kitchen roof they saw Chef Yang's white chef's coat.
strings.去油料区挖油桶: Go dig for fuel drums at the depot
strings.去烧塌的通信室和发电机房里拆还能用的电缆、接头和电源模块，修电台要用。钢架子扭成: Go into the burned-out radio room and generator room to strip usable cable, connectors and power modules for the radio repair. The steel frames are twisted into knots and every edge is sharp.
strings.发动机的声音渐渐听不见了。有人在雪地上站了很久，才回到舱里。: The sound of the engine fades away. Someone stands out on the snow a long time before going back inside.
strings.发动机的轰鸣从黑暗里由远及近——两盏着陆灯刺破了夜色，一架装着雪橇的飞机对准你们: The drone of an engine swells out of the dark — two landing lights cut the night, and a ski-plane lines up on the row of fires you lit and comes down hard on the runway. The pilot jumps out shouting: "Forty minutes on the ground, engines stay running! One kilo over and the flight home gets that much worse — people only. Leave everything else!"
strings.只给他止痛和水，让他少受点罪: Give him only painkillers and water, and let him suffer less
strings.可以留着，但回去以后他得自己去说清楚: It can stay, but when we get home he has to own up to it himself
strings.后来大家才知道：雪地车在冰盖上颠了三天，周宇一路都醒着。到东方站的时候，他还冲着: Only later did they learn: the snow tractor jolted across the ice sheet for three days, and Ethan Zhou was awake the whole way. When they reached Vostok he even managed a smile for the men who came out to carry him.
strings.周宇出院那天，她在病历最后一页签了名，第二年去烧伤科进修了两年。她的诊室里一直摆: On the day Ethan Zhou was discharged she signed the last page of his chart, and the next year she went away for two years of burn training. There is always a roll of cling film in her consulting room; when an intern asks about it she tells them about that winter, and halfway through she always has to stop for a drink of water.
strings.周宇回国以后，每年清明都去河北看他，带一把新扳手，摆在坟前。村里人起初还以为那是: After Ethan Zhou came home he went to Hebei every Qingming to visit him, bringing a new wrench to lay at the grave. At first the villagers took him for the man's son.
strings.周宇清醒了一会儿，声音很轻：“我想……跟我妈说句话。”: Ethan Zhou surfaces for a moment, voice very small: "I want... to say something to my mom."
strings.周宇点点头，闭上了眼睛。: Ethan Zhou nods and closes his eyes.
strings.周宇烧得迷迷糊糊，忽然抓住 {actor} 的手：“那天晚上……2 号机……一股: Feverish and drifting, Ethan Zhou suddenly grabs {actor}'s hand: "That night... No. 2... a strong smell of diesel... I told Master Ma... he said we'd look at it tomorrow..."
strings.周宇瘦得很快。苏敏说，大面积烧伤的人身体像一台空转的发动机，每天要多烧上千大卡，: Ethan Zhou is wasting fast. Monica Su says a badly burned body is like an engine running with no load, burning a thousand extra kcal a day just to close the wounds. But the freezer is still buried under the rubble, and the dry rations in the container shrink every day.
strings.周宇被裹在两个睡袋里，抬进了谢尔盖的雪橇屋。: Ethan Zhou is wrapped in two sleeping bags and carried into Sergey's sledge cabin.
strings.和大家一样，一人一份: The same as everyone: one ration each
strings.和守夜的人聊到天亮: Talk with whoever is on watch until dawn
strings.唐悦一个人拖着雪橇出去了。: Yvonne Tang drags the sledge out alone.
strings.唐悦心理评估的事被查了出来，她被停职审查了半年。复职以后，她主动申请去了越冬队出: The business with Yvonne Tang's psychological evaluation came out, and she was suspended pending review for six months. When she came back she asked to be posted to the medical center that clears winter-over crews before they deploy, read every psychological evaluation twice herself, and never went soft again.
strings.唐悦没有哭，只是一整天都没再说一句话。: Yvonne Tang doesn't cry. She just doesn't say another word all day.
strings.唐悦的秘密会被揭开，站长会对你很失望: Yvonne Tang's secret will come out, and the chief will be deeply disappointed in you
strings.唐悦突然尖叫起来，说舱壁在往里挤、她喘不上气，拼命去拧舱门的把手。外面是零下六十: Yvonne Tang suddenly screams that the walls are pressing in, that she cannot breathe, and she claws at the door handle. Outside is the black at minus sixty.
strings.唐悦红着眼睛来求大家：她三年的冰芯样品还在主楼东头的冷库里——只要冷库没塌，冰芯: Yvonne Tang comes to them red-eyed: her three years of ice cores are still in the freezer at the east end of the main building — if the freezer has not come down, the cores are still there. They are her whole doctorate, and ten years of the station's work.
strings.唐悦被一根掉下来的房梁压住了腿，是听见喊声的人把她拖回来的。: A falling beam pinned Yvonne Tang's leg; the people who heard her shouting dragged her out.
strings.四川口音，说话断断续续，爱说“莫得事”。: Sichuan accent, speaks in fits and starts, fond of saying "It's nothing."
strings.四百米外，头灯照到了她：蜷在一根标志杆底下，已经不会发抖了。大家轮流把她背了回来: Four hundred meters out, a headlamp finds her: curled at the foot of a marker pole, past shivering. They take turns carrying her back.
strings.回国三个月后，事故调查报告发了下来。起火原因：2 号发电机回油管卡箍未紧固，柴油: Three months after they got home the accident report came down. Cause of the fire: the clamp on the fuel return line of Generator No. 2 had not been tightened, and diesel sprayed onto the exhaust. Cause of the failed alarm: the fire-alarm circuit had been deliberately bypassed. On the last page were the signatures of Graham Zheng and Jason Ma. Those who came home alive: {survivors}. Afterwards they were never all in the same room again — even at Chef Yang's memorial, some did not come.
strings.回国以后，他在成都的烧伤科做了十一次植皮，两条胳膊上的疤像一张地图。回电力公司上: Back home he had eleven skin grafts in a Chengdu burn unit, and the scars on both arms look like a map. On his first day back at the power company his old crew noticed that he checked every connector three times. Every June 13 he calls every one of his old Xueling colleagues, one after another.
strings.回国时，土豆在检疫站被扣下了，他在机场哭得像个孩子；三个月后检疫站打电话让他去领: On the way home Spud was seized at quarantine and he cried at the airport like a child; three months later quarantine called and told him to come and collect it. He opened a little noodle shop in Yantai afterwards, with a sign that reads Yang's. Spud lived to be three and is buried under the pomegranate tree in the back yard.
strings.回来以后，姜涛第一次睡了个整觉。: After they got back, Tommy Jiang slept through the night for the first time.
strings.在冰面上压平跑道、立起标志杆、摆好燃烧罐。没有跑道和灯，飞机不敢在极夜里降落。: Pack a runway flat on the ice, stand up the marker poles, set out the flare pots. Without a runway and lights, no plane will land in the polar night.
strings.在心里跟家里人说说话: Talk to your family inside your head
strings.在黑暗里挖了三个钟头，挖出来的是个空桶: Three hours of digging in the dark, and what comes out is an empty drum
strings.堵住所有人的嘴，也会让人起疑: It shuts everyone up — and makes them suspicious
strings.塌下来的房梁压得死死的，什么也翻不出来: The fallen beams have it pinned solid; nothing can be pulled out
strings.外科出身，第二次越冬。火灾时她抱出了一个急救包，现在应急舱里所有的药都在她手上。: Trained as a surgeon, second winter-over. During the fire she carried out one first-aid kit, and now every drug in the container is in her hands. She hardly leaves Ethan Zhou's side.
strings.外面太危险了，等她自己回来: It is too dangerous out there. Wait for her to come back on her own
strings.多出来的那份干粮被泡软了，一勺一勺喂进了周宇嘴里。: The extra ration is soaked soft and spooned into Ethan Zhou's mouth, one spoonful at a time.
strings.夜里睡不着，{actor} 打开笔记本，翻到火灾前一天从站里服务器备份下来的运行: Unable to sleep, {actor} opens the laptop and scrolls to the operating log backed up off the station server the day before the fire: 22:41, abnormal drop in the fuel return pressure of Generator No. 2; and the fire-alarm circuit for the generator room has shown "bypassed" since May 9.
strings.大家把裹着睡袋的杨师傅抬上了飞机，放在最后一排。机长摘下了帽子。: They carry Chef Yang, wrapped in his sleeping bag, onto the plane and lay him in the last row. The pilot takes off his hat.
strings.大面积烧伤：创面每天渗液、极易感染，身体处在高代谢状态，需要的热量比常人多得多；: Major burns: the wound weeps every day and infects easily, the body runs in overdrive and needs far more calories than normal; dressings and antibiotics are limited, and every change of dressing costs one unit. A badly frostbitten foot takes weeks before anyone can tell what is dead and what is still alive, but once it turns to wet gangrene there is not a day to spare.
strings.天上没有云，可地上的雪被风卷起来，一人多高的雪雾贴着冰面流——门口和排气管很快会: No cloud in the sky, but the wind picks the snow up off the ground and drives it along the ice taller than a man — the door and the exhaust will be buried before long.
strings.天快亮时，{actor} 才找到她，几乎是拖着她回来的。: It is nearly light when {actor} finds her and half drags her back.
strings.天气也许会转好，也许不会: The weather may improve. Or it may not
strings.天黑透了（虽然本来就是黑的），唐悦一个人拖着三箱冰芯回来了，手指冻得握不住拳头。: By full dark — though it was already dark — Yvonne Tang comes back alone, dragging three crates of ice cores, fingers too frozen to make a fist.
strings.头灯在油料区晃了一整夜，铁锹砸在冻雪上的声音一直没停。: A headlamp moves around the fuel depot all night, and the sound of a shovel on frozen snow never stops.
strings.头灯的光圈里，一双冻得发紫的手在拆油路。: In the circle of a headlamp, a pair of hands gone purple with cold are taking the fuel line apart.
strings.她很可能回不来: She probably will not come back
strings.她把周宇的护理记录一页一页抄了一遍，寄给了他妈妈，信里只写了一句：“他一直很勇敢: She copied Ethan Zhou's nursing notes out page by page and sent them to his mother, with one line in the letter: "He was brave the whole time. He never once cried." The box of antibiotics in her drawer, unused, she could never bring herself to throw away.
strings.她的冰芯后来被下一支越冬队从废墟里挖了出来，运回了实验室。导师用这些冰芯带出了两: Her ice cores were dug out of the ruins by the next winter-over crew and shipped back to the lab. Her advisor used them to turn out two more doctorates, and the title page of both dissertations carries the same line: "In memory of Yvonne Tang."
strings.她的急救包被带回了医院，里面的东西一样不少——只有抗生素，一剂也不剩。医院后来用: Her first-aid kit went back to the hospital with everything still in it — except the antibiotics, of which not one dose was left. The hospital later named a polar medicine award after her; the first recipient was an intern she had trained.
strings.她的铺位上留着一本没写完的野外记录本，最后一页画着一支冰芯的剖面，每一层都标好了: On her bunk she left a field notebook she never finished; the last page has a cross-section of an ice core, every layer labeled with a year, and on the top layer just two words: this year.
strings.她肚子上那道自己缝的刀口歪歪扭扭，像一条冻僵的蚯蚓。回国后她把那次手术写成了一篇: The incision she sewed into her own belly is crooked, like a frozen earthworm. Back home she wrote the operation up as a case report; the last line reads: "Operator and patient were the same person; the procedure was done in a mirror; instruments were passed by two non-medical crew members." The reviewer had one comment: please supply the operator's heart rate at the time.
strings.如实报告：主楼烧毁、一人遇难、一人重度烧伤、柴油告急: Report it straight: main building destroyed, one dead, one badly burned, diesel running out
strings.如实报告：边缘天气，不建议飞: Report it straight: marginal weather, do not recommend flying
strings.如果以后被拆穿，会更糟: If it comes out later, it will be worse
strings.姜涛会好受很多，舱里也多了个念想；可这是瞒着上面违反条约: It would do Tommy Jiang a world of good and give the container something to hold on to; but it means hiding it from the top and breaking the Treaty
strings.姜涛在那根标志杆前跪了很久，把那袋干粮倒在雪里，又一把一把捧回了袋子里。: Tommy Jiang kneels at the marker pole for a long time. He pours the bag of dry rations out into the snow, then scoops it back into the bag handful by handful.
strings.姜涛每顿饭都多盛一碗，摆在杨师傅原来坐的位置上。今天有人发现，那些饭最后都被他倒: At every meal Tommy Jiang fills an extra bowl and sets it where Chef Yang used to sit. Today someone found out where the food goes: into a plastic bag under his bunk — days of dry rations saved up in it. Asked about it, he says only, "Master is hungry."
strings.姜涛睡了整整十四个钟头。醒来的时候，铺位底下的袋子已经不见了，他也没有问。: Tommy Jiang sleeps fourteen hours straight. When he wakes, the bag under his bunk is gone, and he doesn't ask.
strings.姜涛连连点头，把饼干盒紧紧抱在怀里。: Tommy Jiang nods and nods, the biscuit tin hugged tight to his chest.
strings.定规矩：动刀的人，轮三天班去挖油桶: Make it a rule: whoever holds the knife takes three turns digging for fuel
strings.实在、能扛活、不爱说话；出了事第一个往前冲；对周宇像对亲弟弟。心里压着火灾的事，: Plain, hard-working, a man of few words; the first one forward when something goes wrong; treats Ethan Zhou like a younger brother. The fire sits on his chest, and the moment anyone brings it up he gets short with them and buries himself in work, away from everyone.
strings.小红点突然转了个弯——他们看见了那几点微弱的光！: The little red point suddenly turns — they have seen the faint firelight!
strings.山东烟台人，烹饪学校毕业，跟着杨师傅学了两年白案，第一次越冬。火灾那晚，杨师傅一: From Yantai in Shandong, out of cooking school, two years learning pastries under Chef Yang, first winter-over. The night of the fire Chef Yang shoved him out the kitchen's back door and turned back to shut off the gas valve. He does not have a scratch on him. Every meal in the container now is his — and at every meal he sets out one extra bowl and one extra pair of chopsticks.
strings.巴特尔把自己的狐皮帽子扣在了离他最近的那个人头上：“替我戴着，回去还我。”: Baatar pulls his fox-fur hat down onto the head of whoever is nearest. "Wear it for me. Give it back when we're home."
strings.巴特尔的右脚肿得发亮，脚趾从紫变黑，纱布一揭开就是一股烂肉的腥臭，人也烧了起来。: Baatar's right foot is swollen shiny, the toes gone from purple to black, and when the gauze comes off there is the sweet stink of rotting flesh; he is running a fever too. Anyone with medical sense knows what it is: wet gangrene, and once the toxins are in the blood no drug will help. Either take the front of the foot off now, or put every antibiotic on the table and bet on saving it.
strings.巴特尔被人架到了驾驶室门口，疼得直抽冷气，嘴里却一刻不停：先烤油底壳，再烤蓄电池: Baatar is helped to the cab door, hissing through his teeth, but his mouth never stops: warm the oil pan first, then the battery, throttle halfway — easy now!
strings.巴特尔被抬进了雪橇屋，临走还扯着嗓子喊：“回去请你们喝奶茶！”: Baatar is carried into the sledge cabin, still bellowing as he goes: "Milk tea's on me when we get home!"
strings.带着笔记本里三年的观测数据活着回去: Come home alive with three years of observations in the laptop
strings.帮他把想说的话写下来: Help him write down what he wants to say
strings.应急舱是带保温层的集装箱：暖风机开着，舱里能维持在零下几度，裹着睡袋还算暖和；一: The emergency container is an insulated box: with the heater running it holds a few degrees below zero inside, and inside a sleeping bag it is warm enough; with the heater off, eight people pressed together can only "hold" minus sixty down to minus twenty or thirty, and anyone thinly dressed goes hypothermic within a day or two. The heater burns 14 L of diesel a day, and melting snow burns fuel too whenever the heater is off.
strings.应急舱水箱里的水和几桶瓶装水。之后只能靠化雪。: Water in the container's tank and a few drums of bottled water. After that, only melted snow.
strings.应急舱的炊具箱里翻出一卷保鲜膜，一圈一圈缠在了周宇的胳膊上。: A roll of cling film turns up in the container's cook box, and goes around Ethan Zhou's arms, loop after loop.
strings.应急舱里储备的压缩干粮、罐头和巧克力，按热量计。: The dry rations, cans and chocolate stored in the container, counted in calories.
strings.应急舱里有一台备用短波电台，受潮短路了。要换掉烧坏的元件、接好电源——这活儿只有: There is a spare shortwave radio in the container, shorted out by damp. Burnt components have to be replaced and the power hooked up — only Evan Ho really understands the job; anyone else can only follow the diagrams he draws, slowly.
strings.开雪地车去油料点: Drive the snow tractor to the fuel cache
strings.引擎咳了几声，喷出一股黑烟，终于轰鸣起来。车灯亮起的那一刻，舱里有人欢呼出了声。: The engine coughs, spits black smoke, and finally roars. When the headlights come on, someone in the container actually cheers.
strings.强迫自己按点作息，到点就熄灯: Force yourself onto a schedule: lights out on time, every time
strings.当场揭穿: Call it out on the spot
strings.当着所有人的面说出来: Say it in front of everyone
strings.心理评估的事被查了出来，她休学了一年。复学以后，她换了导师，改做冰川数值模型，再: The business with the psychological evaluation came out, and she took a year off. When she went back she changed advisors, switched to numerical glacier modeling, and never went to Antarctica again. Under the glass on her desk is a note she wrote in the emergency container: "Survived today too."
strings.忍着，把药留给周宇他们: Bite it down; save the medicine for Ethan Zhou and the others
strings.慢慢把生物钟拽回来: Slowly haul the body clock back
strings.截掉前脚掌：用马建军工具箱里的钢锯: Take off the front of the foot: with the hacksaw from Jason Ma's toolbox
strings.所有人会冻得够呛，但能把毒气放出去: Everyone will freeze hard, but the gas gets out
strings.所有人只带着身上的衣服，一个接一个钻进了机舱。: Carrying nothing but the clothes they stand in, they file into the cabin one after another.
strings.所有人打着头灯冲进黑暗，一边喊她的名字，一边沿着脚印往前追。: Everyone runs into the dark with headlamps on, shouting her name and following the footprints.
strings.所有人拿头灯和手电朝天上晃: Everyone waves headlamps and torches up at the sky
strings.所有人挤成一团，听着彼此的牙齿打战，一直熬到暖风机重新转起来。: Everyone crowds into one knot, listening to each other's teeth chatter, and holds out until the heater turns over again.
strings.所有人挤进同一堆睡袋，抱在一起熬: Everyone piles into the same heap of sleeping bags and holds on together
strings.所有人用绳子串成一串，沿着降落伞落下的方向，一步一步走进了黑暗。: Everyone ties onto one rope, one behind another, and walks step by step into the dark, toward where the parachutes came down.
strings.所有人的睡袋拼成一张大床，谁也不许睡在边上。有人小声数着数，一直数到早上。: All the sleeping bags are laid out as one big bed, and nobody is allowed to sleep on the edge. Someone counts under their breath, and keeps counting until morning.
strings.所有人跑到雪地上，拼命挥动手里的灯。: Everyone runs out onto the snow, waving their lights for all they are worth.
strings.所有人都挤进雪橇屋，跟他去东方站: All of them cram into the sledge cabin and ride to Vostok with him
strings.所有人都知道火是从 {actor} 修过的那台发电机烧起来的了。{actor}: Everyone knows now that the fire started in the generator {actor} had worked on. {actor} sits in the corner all night, then suddenly looks up at the chief: "But why didn't the alarm go off? Who told me to bypass that circuit?"
strings.所有人马上出去找: Everyone goes out to search now
strings.所有能动的人，连夜去油料区挖油: Everyone still able to move goes to dig fuel at the depot through the night
strings.所有能走的人一起去，把包裹都找回来: Everyone who can walk goes together and brings all the bundles back
strings.手术做了一个小时四十分钟。{actor} 中途停下来两次，等眩晕过去。最后一针缝: The operation takes an hour and forty minutes. {actor} stops twice to let the dizziness pass. When the last stitch is in she says, "Done. Who's going to boil some water?"
strings.手脚勤快、话少，总想讨好每一个人；把杨师傅当亲爹。内疚和失眠正在一点点把他掏空：: Quick and willing, spare with words, always trying to please everyone; he looks on Chef Yang as a father. Guilt and sleeplessness are hollowing him out: by day he looks the same as ever, at night he talks to an empty bunk. Every day he has to go back to the freezer for supplies, and the freezer is one wall away from the kitchen where Chef Yang went down.
strings.扑上去夺刀: Lunge in and take the knife away
strings.扔回废墟里: Throw it back into the ruins
strings.找到天亮，脚印被吹雪抹平了。: They search until dawn; the blowing snow has smoothed the footprints away.
strings.找回来的包裹里只有药和吃的——装电话和柴油的那两个，不知道落在了哪里。: The bundles they brought back held only medicine and food — the two with the phone and the diesel are somewhere out there, and nobody knows where.
strings.把他挖出来，好好安放在雪里: Dig him out and lay him properly in the snow
strings.把他的口粮减下来，留给出去干活的人: Cut his ration and give it to the people working outside
strings.把他的话告诉大家: Tell the others what he said
strings.把吃的收回来，跟他说清楚：杨师傅已经不在了: Take the food back and tell him straight: Chef Yang is gone
strings.把她按住，绑在铺位上: Hold her down and tie her to the bunk
strings.把抗生素都给他，赌这只脚能保住: Give him all the antibiotics and bet on saving the foot
strings.把暖风机调到最低档: Turn the heater down to its lowest setting
strings.把杨师傅的遗体抬上飞机——冰芯就只能留下: Load Chef Yang's body onto the plane — the ice cores stay behind
strings.把柴油倒进空油桶里点着，在雪地上烧出一个大火堆: Tip diesel into an empty drum and set it alight, a big fire on the snow
strings.把油全抽出来给暖风机烧: Drain all the fuel and burn it in the heater
strings.把电池揣在怀里捂一整天再试: Carry the battery against your chest all day, then try again
strings.把话咽回去，一个人扛下所有的责任: Swallow it and carry all the blame yourself
strings.把货箱、床板、书架，能烧的木头全劈了，塞进化雪炉: Chop up the crates, the bunk boards, the bookshelf — anything wooden — and feed it to the snow stove
strings.把这张牌留到最后: Keep that card for the end
strings.抓紧时间睡一会: Grab some sleep while you can
strings.抗生素 −3；大多数阑尾炎吃药能压下去，压不住就会穿孔: Antibiotics −3; most appendicitis settles on drugs — and when it doesn't, it ruptures
strings.抗生素 −4。药用完了，周宇和别人再感染就没得救: Antibiotics −4. That empties the supply — if Ethan Zhou or anyone else gets an infection after this, there is nothing left
strings.折腾了半夜，暖风机直到天亮才重新转起来。: They fight with it half the night; the heater does not turn over again until dawn.
strings.抢在他前头，自己向所有人坦白: Get ahead of him and confess to everyone yourself
strings.报告一条一条念完了。电台那头沉默了很久，说：“明白。我们马上报告国内，准备冬季飞: The report is read out, item by item. The radio is silent a long time, then: "Understood. We're reporting to the mainland now. Preparing a winter flight."
strings.报平安：撑得住，等安全的窗口: Report all well: we can hold, wait for a safe window
strings.报得乐观一点：“能见度够，可以飞”: Report it rosy: "Visibility is good enough. You can fly."
strings.报警旁路的事写进了事故调查报告。他被撤了站长，提前办了退休。后来他在哈尔滨一所中: The bypassed alarm went into the accident report. He was removed as chief and took early retirement. Later he worked as a science guide at a middle school in Harbin, talking to children about Antarctica; every time he came to the photograph of Xueling Station he would stop for a long moment, then turn the page without a word.
strings.抱住她，陪她说话，直到她平静下来: Hold her and stay with her, talking, until she settles
strings.拆了笔记本的电池: Strip the battery out of the laptop
strings.拆何远笔记本的电池给它供电: Take Evan Ho's laptop battery to power it
strings.拆通信室和机房: Strip the radio room and the generator room
strings.拉着雪橇沿旗线走到六公里外的跑道油料点，把夏天留下的油桶拖回来。要在黑暗和零下六: Haul a sledge along the flag line to the runway fuel cache six kilometers out and drag back the drums summer left there. It takes a whole day of walking in the dark at minus sixty, and that night there is nothing to do but shelter in the empty container at the cache and burn a can of fuel until morning.
strings.拖着雪橇（有雪地车就开车）压平跑道、立标志杆、摆燃烧罐。没有跑道和灯，飞机在极夜: With a sledge, or the snow tractor if it runs, pack the runway flat, stand the marker poles, set out the flare pots. Without a runway and lights, no plane dares land in the polar night.
strings.按住他，让苏敏打一针镇静剂: Hold him down while Monica Su gives him a sedative
strings.按俄国人的规矩，第三杯敬不在了的人: Russian custom: the third glass is for those who are gone
strings.按规定处理：放到舱外去: Do it by the book: put it outside
strings.挖个雪洞，躲到风小了再走: Dig a snow cave and wait out the wind
strings.挖出半桶南极柴油，冻得像猪油，得抬进舱里捂化了才能用: Half a drum of Antarctic diesel comes out frozen like lard; it has to be carried inside and thawed before it will burn
strings.敷料 −2、抗生素 −1；动刀的人手要稳。巴特尔从此走不了远路，可命多半能保住: Dressings −2, antibiotics −1; the hand on the saw has to be steady. Baatar will never walk far again, but he will most likely live
strings.敷料 −2、抗生素 −2，感染的风险会小很多；以后别人受伤就不够了: Dressings −2, antibiotics −2; much less risk of infection, and nothing left for the next person who gets hurt
strings.斧子劈了一下午。化雪炉烧得通红，舱里弥漫着呛人的烟——可总算暖和了一点。: The axe works all afternoon. The snow stove glows red and acrid smoke fills the container — but at least it is warmer.
strings.新滤芯装上，暖风机呼的一声又转了起来。: The new filter goes in and the heater whooshes back to life.
strings.新的天线在两根杆子之间绷直了，在星光下像一根细细的琴弦。: The new antenna runs taut between the two masts, a thin fiddle string under the stars.
strings.早上，有人怎么叫也叫不醒，其他人头疼得像要裂开，一站起来就想吐——暖风机的排气管: In the morning one of them cannot be woken no matter how hard they shake him, and the rest have headaches splitting their skulls and want to vomit the moment they stand — the heater's exhaust was blocked by snow, and the fumes backed up into the sealed container all night.
strings.暖风机停了。舱里一下子安静下来，呼出的气开始在舱壁上结霜。: The heater stops. The container goes quiet, and breath begins to frost on the walls.
strings.暖风机停着的那一夜，舱里冷得滴水成冰。早上，姜涛怀里的土豆蜷成一个小球，再也没有: The night the heater was off it was cold enough to freeze water solid. In the morning Spud lay curled into a small ball against Tommy Jiang's chest, and did not wake up.
strings.暖风机和化雪炉都烧它。暖风机开一天要烧 14 升。: Both the heater and the snow stove burn it. A day of heating costs 14 L.
strings.暖风机最后一次被关掉。所有人裹着睡袋挤进了雪橇屋，应急舱的门被一根铁丝拧死了。: The heater is switched off for the last time. Everyone crowds into the sledge cabin in their sleeping bags, and the door of the emergency container is wired shut.
strings.暖风机的出风口对准了雪地车的油底壳，烤了整整一个白天。: The heater's vent is aimed at the snow tractor's oil pan and left there a whole day.
strings.暖风机的嗡嗡声低了下去。所有人把睡袋的拉链一直拉到了下巴。: The hum of the heater drops lower. Everyone pulls their sleeping bag zippers up to the chin.
strings.暖风机的排气管伸在舱外，吹雪会把它埋住。堵得越严重，废气越容易倒灌进舱里。: The heater's exhaust sticks out beyond the container, and blowing snow buries it. The worse the blockage, the more easily the fumes back up inside.
strings.暖风机的油箱见了底。昨晚舱里的温度掉到了零下二十几度，水壶冻成了冰坨，有人的嘴唇: The heater's tank is down to the dregs. Last night the temperature inside fell to the minus twenties, the water bottle froze into a block, and some lips have gone purple. Another night like that and someone will not wake up.
strings.暖风机虽然费油，至少不会把人熏死: The heater drinks fuel, but at least it does not gas anyone to death
strings.最后一次有人看见她，是背着急救包走出舱门的背影。那个急救包后来在旗线边上找到了，: The last time anyone saw her it was her back going out the door with the first-aid kit. The kit was found later beside the flag line, zipped shut.
strings.最后几支头孢被一支一支推进了巴特尔的血管。: The last vials of cephalosporin go into Baatar's veins, one after another.
strings.最后有人看见他一个人站在跑道那头，仰着头看天，像是在数云。第二年夏天，补给队在那: The last sighting of him was alone at the far end of the runway, head back, looking at the sky as if counting clouds. The next summer the supply team found a frost-cracked thermometer there.
strings.最后那些天，拿主意的已经不是他了。回国后有人请他去讲越冬经验，他一律推掉。只有一: In those last days he was no longer the one deciding anything. Back home people asked him to lecture on winter-over experience and he turned them all down. Only once, drunk, he said to an empty glass: "That night, if the alarm had gone off..." Nobody ever heard the rest.
strings.最安全。冰芯、遗体、所有行李都留在冰盖上: Safest of all. The ice cores, the body, all the baggage stay on the ice sheet
strings.最快解决问题；可中了毒的人还要在外面冻着: Solves it fastest; but the people who breathed the gas still have to freeze outside
strings.最省事，可她会恨你们: Least trouble — and she will hate you for it
strings.有人举着电话跑到门外找信号，手指几乎按不动按键。: Someone runs outside holding the phone up for signal, fingers barely able to work the keys.
strings.有人从侧面扑了上去。: Someone comes at him from the side.
strings.有人在姜涛的铺位底下翻出一个饼干铁盒，盒盖上扎满了小眼——里面窝着一只仓鼠。《南: Someone found a biscuit tin under Tommy Jiang's bunk, its lid punched full of tiny holes — a hamster curled up inside. The Antarctic Treaty forbids bringing any outside animal onto the continent, and this would have to be reported. Tommy Jiang drops to his knees: "His name is Spud. I smuggled him onto the ship in Shanghai... The day of the fire I kept him inside my coat the whole time."
strings.有人当着所有人的面问 {actor}：“周宇到底还能撑多久？你给句实话——我们是: Someone asks {actor} in front of everyone: "How much longer can Ethan Zhou really last? Give us a straight answer — are we supposed to put the medicine and the food on him?"
strings.有人扑上去抓住了拿刀的手腕。: Someone lunges in and catches the wrist holding the knife.
strings.有人把剩下的烧伤敷料全塞进了周宇的睡袋，一遍一遍地跟谢尔盖比划怎么换药。: Someone stuffs all the remaining burn dressings into Ethan Zhou's sleeping bag and shows Sergey again and again how to change them.
strings.有人把她搂进怀里，一遍一遍地说：“我在呢，我在呢。”: Someone gathers her into their arms and says it over and over: "I'm here. I'm here."
strings.有人拉下面罩，又冲向了火场。: Someone pulls down their mask and runs back into the fire.
strings.有人握着笔，一个字一个字地记下了周宇说的话。写到一半，停下来擦了擦眼睛。: Someone holds a pen and writes down what Ethan Zhou says, word by word. Halfway through they stop and wipe their eyes.
strings.有人说最后那几天，在旗线的尽头看见过他的头灯，一闪一闪地往车库那边去了。后来车库: Some say that in those last days they saw his headlamp at the end of the flag line, blinking away toward the garage. Later a shelter was found in the garage, built out of canvas and fuel drums. There was no one in it.
strings.机长看了一眼箱子，摇了摇头：“人，或者冰。你们自己选。”冰芯箱被留在了跑道边的雪: The pilot looks at the crates and shakes his head: "People, or ice. Your choice." The ice-core crates are left in the snow beside the runway.
strings.机长骂了一句，挥手让人把冰芯箱塞进了货舱。: The pilot swears once and waves them into the cargo hold with the ice-core crates.
strings.杨师傅的追悼会上摆着两张照片。姜涛的那张是在雪龙号的甲板上照的，他穿着白色的厨师: Two photographs stood at Chef Yang's memorial. Tommy Jiang's was taken on the deck of the icebreaker Xue Long: white chef's coat, eyes squeezed shut with laughing, a small furry thing cupped in his palm — and only when the print came back did anyone see what it was.
strings.杨师傅那把用了二十年的菜刀，刀把已经烧没了: Chef Yang's cleaver, twenty years in his hand, its handle burned away
strings.极地气压偏低，海拔 3050 米的冰盖，人体感受到的“生理海拔”约 3400 米: Polar pressure runs low, and at 3,050 meters on the ice sheet the body feels a "physiological altitude" of about 3,400 meters: breathing loses more water, heat burn runs a tenth higher, and hard labor can bring on altitude sickness. The air is desperately dry; without melting snow you dehydrate fast.
strings.极夜尽头: The end of the polar night
strings.柴油 +80 升左右，马上就能用: Diesel +80 L or so, usable immediately
strings.柴油 −20 升。在漆黑的冰盖上，火光几十公里外都看得见: Diesel −20 L. On the black ice sheet, a fire can be seen from tens of kilometers away
strings.柴油 −3 升；冻伤会好得快很多: Diesel −3 L; the frostbite will heal far faster
strings.柴油多一倍；可他就回不去了——东方站这个冬天要少一个机械师: Twice the fuel — but then he cannot go home: Vostok loses its only mechanic for the winter
strings.核心体温逐小时计算：在零下六十多度的户外干重活，穿全套极地服每小时也要掉零点五度: Core temperature, hour by hour: doing hard work outdoors at minus sixty, even in full polar gear you lose about half a degree an hour, faster the more thinly you are dressed, and fingers and toes can freeze. Shivering burns a great deal of energy, and cold and hunger accelerate each other.
strings.每个人的饭盒里都一样多。周宇说：“莫得事，我也吃不下那么多。”: Everyone's mess tin gets the same. Ethan Zhou says, "It's nothing. I couldn't eat that much anyway."
strings.每天多给他一份口粮: One extra ration a day for him
strings.每天能省下 4 升油；舱里会冷到零下十几度，大家要多耗热量、睡不踏实: Saves 4 L of fuel a day; the container drops to the minus teens, everyone burns more energy and sleeps badly
strings.每天额外用掉 900 千卡食物，他才有力气扛过去: Costs an extra 900 kcal of food a day — and that is what gives him the strength to hold on
strings.每次要用掉 1 个电台零件。何远凭记忆里的电路图干，一天能干完一大截；别人只能照: Each session costs one radio part. Working from the circuit diagrams in his head, Evan Ho gets through a large share in a day; anyone else can only follow the drawings he makes, slowly.
strings.毒气不会再来，可舱里会迅速冷下去: The gas will not come back, but the container will cool fast
strings.求他把回程的那桶油也留下，等飞机来了一起走: Ask him to leave the drum he needs to get home, and wait for the plane with them
strings.求机长带上唐悦的冰芯箱: Ask the pilot to take Yvonne Tang's ice-core crates
strings.沉默、固执、乐观得近乎宿命；手比嘴快，什么东西坏了先上手修；最烦被当成客人；对“: Quiet, stubborn, cheerful to the edge of fatalism; his hands move faster than his mouth, and anything broken gets taken apart before anyone is asked; hates being treated as a guest; does not think much of orders from above.
strings.没人看周宇。他听见了，把脸转向了舱壁。: Nobody looks at Ethan Zhou. He heard it anyway, and turns his face to the wall.
strings.没有人看巴特尔。他自己把纱布重新缠好，哼起了一首谁也听不懂的歌。: Nobody looks at Baatar. He rewraps the gauze himself and hums a song no one else knows.
strings.没有人说得清最后那段路他是怎么走的。第二年夏天，补给队在离应急舱两公里的冰面上捡: Nobody can say how he walked that last stretch. The next summer the supply team picked up his hat on the ice two kilometers from the emergency container, the chief's badge still pinned to the brim.
strings.没有人说话。有人在那件工作服上盖了一块铁皮。: Nobody speaks. Someone lays a sheet of tin over the coat.
strings.河北口音，话少，爱说“行”“我来”“别磨叽”。: Hebei accent, few words, fond of saying "Right," "I'll do it," "Stop dawdling."
strings.油一桶一桶地从雪地车里抽了出来，像从一头冬眠的野兽身上抽血。: The fuel is drawn out of the snow tractor drum by drum, like bleeding a hibernating animal.
strings.油会烧得更快——从明天起，必须天天有人出去挖油桶: The fuel will burn faster — from tomorrow somebody has to go out and dig for drums every single day
strings.油料区离应急舱两百米，几十个油桶埋在一人多深、冻得像水泥的雪里。挖上三个钟头，运: The fuel depot is two hundred meters from the container, and dozens of drums lie under snow taller than a man, frozen hard as concrete. Three hours of digging brings up half a drum of Antarctic diesel if you are lucky. Heavy work, and at minus sixty frostbite comes easily.
strings.油料点应急箱里的一部旧铱星电话，电池冻得冰凉: An old Iridium phone in the emergency box at the fuel cache, its battery cold as iron
strings.活着回去，把三年的冰芯带回实验室: Get home alive and bring three years of ice cores back to the lab
strings.派人陪她去，把冰芯抢出来: Send someone with her and get the ice cores out
strings.派最熟悉冰原的人沿着脚印去追: Send whoever knows the ice best to follow the tracks
strings.海岸站和国内对雪岭站失联的警觉程度。: How alarmed Coast Station and the mainland are at losing contact with Xueling.
strings.海岸站在电台里问：“雪岭站，报一下实况——云高、能见度、风速。飞行员在等你们的数: Coast Station asks over the radio: "Xueling, give us the actual conditions — cloud ceiling, visibility, wind speed. The pilots are waiting on your numbers to decide whether they launch." {actor} walks to the door and looks: the cloud sits low, and the marker poles at the far end of the runway come and go.
strings.混乱里刀划了下去。血滴在舱板上，很快冻成了暗红色的冰点。: In the confusion the knife comes down. Blood drips onto the floor and freezes quickly into dark red beads.
strings.清排气管和门口: Clear the exhaust and the doorway
strings.满天星斗，极光在头顶流动，一丝风也没有——这是冰盖上最冷的天气。: A sky full of stars, aurora streaming overhead, not a breath of wind — this is the coldest weather the ice sheet has.
strings.滴油炉比暖风机省油得多；可舱顶开了洞，烟囱一堵，一氧化碳也来得更快: The drip stove is far more frugal than the heater; but it means a hole in the roof, and if the chimney plugs, carbon monoxide comes faster too
strings.火堆烧起来了，可那个小红点没有转向，慢慢消失在了星空里。: The fire blazes up, but the little red point does not turn. It fades slowly into the stars.
strings.火是从你那天下午检修的 2 号发电机烧起来的。换完燃油滤芯，你记得回油管的卡箍还: The fire started in Generator No. 2, the one you serviced that afternoon. After the fuel filter change you remember the clamp on the return line was not fully tightened — you were in a hurry for dinner and told yourself you would come back and check, and then you forgot. And that fire-alarm circuit: you bypassed it yourself, on the chief's orders.
strings.火灾后的第一个钟头。在极夜里，天永远不会亮——只有主楼的火光，把整片冰原照成了橘: The first hour after the fire. In the polar night the sky will never lighten — only the flames of the main building, turning the whole ice sheet orange. Eight people are crammed into the emergency container: Ethan Zhou lies in the middle, his scorched clothing fused to his arms; Baatar's feet are frozen like wood. Chef Yang did not come out, and Tommy Jiang, the kitchen hand, has been pressed against the little window in the door ever since. The fire has not reached the freezer and the infirmary at the east end yet — but it will not be long.
strings.火灾后第二十八天，在整整四个星期联系不上雪岭站之后，一架雪橇飞机冒险飞了一千公里: Twenty-eight days after the fire, after four full weeks without contact from Xueling Station, a ski-plane took the risk and flew a thousand kilometers, landing on unlit ice. The survivors the crew found were: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see that day: {dead}.
strings.火灾后第二十八天，在整整四个星期联系不上雪岭站之后，海岸站决定赌一次。飞机趁着一: Twenty-eight days after the fire, after four full weeks without contact from Xueling Station, Coast Station decided to gamble. The plane flew a thousand kilometers through the dark on a brief warm spell, and when it touched down the crew saw the door of the emergency container open — people coming out one after another, waving at minus sixty, and the last thing carried out was a wounded man wrapped in a sleeping bag. {survivors}, every one of them.
strings.火灾那晚你在观测场，是第一个看见发电机房冒烟的人。可你先跑回宿舍去抢你的笔记本电: The night of the fire you were out at the observation field and you were the first to see smoke coming from the generator room. But you ran back to the dormitory first to save your laptop — three years of unbacked-up data — and lost several minutes before you raised the alarm. If you had shouted sooner, Ethan Zhou might not have had to go in alone.
strings.火灾那晚值夜班，第一个发现机房起火。他一个人冲进去拉总闸，两条胳膊、前胸和后背都: On watch the night of the fire, the first to spot the generator room burning. He ran in alone to throw the main breaker and was burned across both arms, his chest and his back, and breathed in a lot of smoke. It hurts, but he rarely makes a sound.
strings.火苗一下子窜起两人多高，把半个天都映红了。: The flames leap two men high and paint half the sky red.
strings.烧伤敷料、纱布、生理盐水和夹板。烧伤每换一次药就要用掉一份。: Burn dressings, gauze, saline and splints. Every burn dressing change costs one unit.
strings.烧热水，好好泡开: Boil water and soak it open properly
strings.照样过节：拿出最好的吃的，吃一顿饱饭: Keep the holiday anyway: bring out the best food and eat a full meal
strings.熔成一团的卫星终端和对讲机，什么也用不上: A satellite terminal and a walkie-talkie melted into one lump, useless for anything
strings.熬到救援，而且直到最后都是你说了算: Hold out until rescue, and stay the one giving orders to the very end
strings.爬上主楼旁的天线杆，在零下六十多度里拉一条几十米长的偶极天线。手套一摘，手指几分: Climb the mast beside the main building and run a dipole tens of meters long at minus sixty. Take a glove off and your fingers go stiff in minutes.
strings.狂风夹着雪砸在舱壁上，整个集装箱都在嗡嗡震动。出门三步就看不见舱门。: Wind drives snow against the walls and the whole container hums with it. Three steps from the door and you cannot see the door.
strings.现在就试，能说几句是几句: Try now; say whatever can be said
strings.用保鲜膜包住创面，省着用敷料: Wrap the burns in cling film and stretch the dressings
strings.用掉 1 份急救用品；以后每天都得有人盯着他: Costs 1 unit of medical supplies; from now on somebody has to watch him every day
strings.用掉 1 份急救用品；她能睡上一整天: Costs 1 unit of medical supplies; she will sleep a whole day
strings.用最好的办法治：敷料、抗生素先紧着他用: Treat him with everything: dressings and antibiotics go to him first
strings.用电台给他接通国内: Use the radio to put him through to home
strings.用电台给别的站发仲冬祝福: Send Midwinter greetings to the other stations by radio
strings.用雪使劲搓，搓热了就好: Rub it hard with snow; once it is warm it is fine
strings.由他去吧，每顿给杨师傅留一碗: Let him be, and set out a bowl for Chef Yang at every meal
strings.电台修得差不多了，可应急舱的蓄电池一发射就掉电——这种低温下，只有何远那台笔记本: The radio is nearly fixed, but the container's battery drops out the moment it transmits — at these temperatures only the lithium battery in Evan Ho's laptop still holds up.
