Strip it out for a power supply and the radio will come on within the hour. But that laptop holds three years of observations, never backed up.
strings.电台的面板亮了，喇叭里传出沙沙的底噪。: The radio's panel lights up and the speaker hisses with static.
strings.电台要多修几天: The radio will take a few more days
strings.电台那头说：“好，我们等。”: The voice on the radio says, "All right. We'll wait."
strings.电台那头转了三次线。周宇听见妈妈声音的时候，眼泪顺着烧伤的脸流了下来。: The call is patched through three times. When Ethan Zhou hears his mother's voice, tears run down his burned face.
strings.电池被贴着胸口揣了一整天。: The battery rides against someone's chest all day.
strings.电池随时会冻掉: The battery could die at any moment
strings.电缆、接头、电源模块。修电台每干一次活要用掉一个。: Cable, connectors, power modules. Every session on the radio costs one.
strings.电话亮了一下，又灭了。电池早就冻坏了。: The phone lights once and dies. The battery froze through long ago.
strings.电话屏幕亮了，信号格跳到了三格。: The phone screen lights up and the signal bars jump to three.
strings.留下它，这件事谁也不往外说: Keep it, and nobody says a word about it
strings.疼了三天，竟然慢慢缓了过来。{actor} 说，也许只是一场肠痉挛。可她自己知道: Three days of pain, and then it slowly eased. {actor} says it may just have been a bowel spasm. She knows better.
strings.直到最后一天，说了算的一直是他。总结会上他一个人讲了四十分钟，从头到尾没说过一个: To the last day he was the one giving the orders. At the debrief he talked for forty minutes alone and never once said the word "I." The next year he did not sign up for winter-over again; he installed the most expensive smoke alarm in the compound and presses the test button once a month — the neighbors are used to the shrieking.
strings.省油，但可能会感染: Saves fuel, but infection may set in
strings.省着油，飞机还会再来的: Go easy on the fuel. The plane will come again
strings.看方向感；走错了就是往冰盖深处走: Depends on a sense of direction; go wrong and you walk deeper into the ice sheet
strings.看谁劝得住；拉架的人可能挨一刀: Depends on who can talk him down; whoever steps in may take the knife
strings.看谁手快；刀在一个好几天没睡的人手里，谁也说不准: Depends on who is quicker; with the knife in the hands of a man who hasn't slept in days, nothing is certain
strings.看谁最会安抚人: Depends on who is best at soothing him
strings.看谁最会说话；说不通，他可能伤人，也可能伤自己: Depends on who can talk; if words fail he may hurt someone, or himself
strings.睡不着就起来干点活: When you cannot sleep, get up and do some work
strings.私下找他分一块: Go to him privately and split a piece
strings.私下拿去问老马: Take it to Old Ma privately
strings.私藏的东西会被充公: Anything kept hidden will be confiscated
strings.立威，但何远会记恨: Establishes your authority, and Evan Ho will hold it against you
strings.站长会不满: The chief will not be pleased
strings.站长会记你的情: The chief will owe you one
strings.站长的事也会被揭开: The chief's part will come out too
strings.站长盯着她看了半天，摔下一句：“回去再跟你算。”: The chief stares at her a long moment, then throws down: "We'll settle this when we're home."
strings.笔记本没能带回来，三年的数据只剩下脑子里的一些数字。第二年他又报名越冬，回到冰盖: The laptop did not come home; of three years of data only some numbers in his head were left. He signed up for the next winter-over and went back to the ice sheet to measure it all again from scratch. Someone asked him whether it was worth it. He said, "Pressure doesn't lie."
strings.笔记本的后盖被拧开了。何远一直盯着那块电池，一句话也没说。: The laptop's back plate comes off. Evan Ho stares at the battery the whole time and says nothing.
strings.第一次来南极，来钻冰芯、做博士论文。火灾时她只穿着保暖内衣就跑了出来，身上那件羽: First time in Antarctica, here to drill ice cores and write a dissertation. During the fire she got out in her thermal underwear; the down jacket she wears was thrown to her by the chief, and the wind pants came out of a storage box in the container, two sizes too big. She has barely spoken these last days, and lies awake most of the night.
strings.第三天，{actor} 的烧退了，右下腹的剧痛一点点变成了隐痛。: On the third day {actor}'s fever breaks, and the stabbing pain in the right lower belly fades to a dull ache.
strings.第三天，巴特尔的烧退了，脚上的红肿也一点点消了下去。: On the third day Baatar's fever breaks and the swelling in his foot slowly goes down.
strings.第二天一早，把日志念给所有人听: The next morning, read the log out to everyone
strings.第二天夜里，周宇在颠簸的雪橇屋里停止了呼吸。谢尔盖没有掉头，他把周宇一路带到了东: The next night, in the jolting sledge cabin, Ethan Zhou stops breathing. Sergey does not turn around. He carries him all the way to Vostok — to wait for the ship next summer.
strings.第二天夜里，疼痛忽然消失了——然后是更凶的高烧。阑尾穿孔了。: The next night the pain suddenly vanishes — and then the fever comes back worse. The appendix has ruptured.
strings.第二天早上，{actor} 和何远谁也没提昨晚的事。: The next morning neither {actor} nor Evan Ho mentions the night before.
strings.第二天，{actor} 当着所有人的面说：“往后听何远的。”没人知道为什么。: The next day {actor} says in front of everyone, "From now on, we do what Evan Ho says." Nobody knows why.
strings.第二天，雪地车的液压管在零下六十七度里冻裂了。谢尔盖在车底下趴了六个钟头，手指冻: The next day the snow tractor's hydraulic line split at minus sixty-seven. Sergey lay under the machine for six hours, fingers purple, and it still would not move again. They crammed into the sledge cabin for four days before a tractor arrived from Vostok.
strings.第四天凌晨，雪地车的灯照见了东方站的天线杆。站上的十几个俄国人全跑了出来，有人脚: Before dawn on the fourth day the tractor's lights found the antenna masts of Vostok. A dozen Russians poured out of the station, some still in slippers. When the door of the sledge cabin opened, a wave of diesel smoke and sweat came out with it — and not one of them was missing. The Vostok cook filled a bowl of borscht for each of them; nobody spoke, and all you could hear was spoons on bowls. Those who walked in alive: {survivors}.
strings.第四天，{actor} 疼得蜷成一团，烧到了四十度。阑尾穿孔了。: On the fourth day {actor} is curled into a ball with pain and running a forty-degree fever. The appendix has ruptured.
strings.第四次越冬，第一次当站长。火灾那晚，是他挨个砸门把所有人叫醒、点着名带出了主楼。: Fourth winter-over, first as chief. The night of the fire he went door to door hammering until everyone was awake, then called the roll and led them out of the main building. The most respected man on the crew, and the least able to stand being questioned.
strings.等回去以后，亲手交给他妈妈: When we get home, put it into his mother's hands yourself
strings.等飞机来了，让救援的人来: Wait for the plane and let the rescue team do it
strings.管发电机、暖风机、雪地车和全站的管线，什么机器到他手里都能响。火着起来时他冲进机: Runs the generators, the heater, the snow tractor and every line on the station; any machine in his hands will run. When the fire started he ran into the generator room to shut down the fuel pump and burned the back of his right hand. Ethan Zhou was his apprentice, trained by him from nothing.
strings.红灯的小点转了个弯，朝着火光飞了过来，在头顶低低地掠过，摇了摇机翼——他们看见了: The red point banks, comes in toward the firelight, passes low overhead and rocks its wings — they have seen us!
strings.给他一个自己开口的机会: Give him the chance to speak for himself
strings.给大家，也给自己一点希望: Give everyone, yourself included, something to hope for
strings.罐头都被打开了。有人用饭盒敲着节拍唱起了歌，唱着唱着，好几个人都哭了。: The cans all get opened. Someone beats time on a mess tin and starts to sing, and before the song is over several of them are crying.
strings.老一辈传下来的土办法: A homemade remedy handed down from the old people
strings.老马和站长的事都会被揭开: Both Old Ma's part and the chief's will come out
strings.老马接过滤芯座，手抖得厉害。他求 {actor} 别说出去。: Old Ma takes the filter housing and his hands shake badly. He begs {actor} not to tell anyone.
strings.老马的秘密会被揭开: Old Ma's secret will come out
strings.耳机里传来一个接一个的声音：海岸站、康科迪亚、东方站、南极点……每一个站都在问：: Voice after voice comes through the headphones: Coast Station, Concordia, Vostok, South Pole... every one of them asking, "Xueling, are you all right?"
strings.联系上之后，冬季救援飞行的准备进度。: Once contact is made, how far the winter rescue flight has been prepared.
strings.聪明、敏感、有点清高；对数字和天气近乎偏执地认真；看不惯站长的作风，但从不当面顶: Clever, sensitive, a little aloof; almost obsessive about numbers and weather; despises the chief's style but never says so to his face, keeping his own accounts in silence.
strings.聪明但脆弱；害怕被当成累赘，于是拼命表现；情绪会突然崩掉又突然恢复；三年的冰芯是: Clever but brittle; terrified of being a burden, so she performs twice as hard; her moods crash and recover without warning; the three years of ice cores are the only thing she can hold on to.
strings.胶东口音，管谁都叫“老师”，张嘴就是“俺师父说过……”“吃了没？再吃点”。: Jiaodong accent, calls everyone "teacher," and every other sentence is "My master always said..." or "Have you eaten? Have some more."
strings.能抢多少是多少；烧着的楼随时会塌: Get out whatever can be got; a burning building comes down without warning
strings.能收回几千大卡的口粮；对他来说，等于再失去一次师父: Gets back a few thousand kcal of rations; to him it is the same as losing his master a second time
strings.能顶替一晚上的柴油；可在密闭的舱里烧木头，烟和一氧化碳会更重: Replaces one night's diesel; but burning wood in a sealed container means far more smoke and carbon monoxide
strings.自己冲出去把排气管挖开: Run out yourself and dig the exhaust clear
strings.舱门关上了。所有人坐着，谁也没睡。: The door closes. Everyone sits. Nobody sleeps.
strings.舱门关上了。苏敏跪在周宇身边，一点一点剪开粘在他皮肤上的衣服。外面的火一直烧到天: The door closes. Monica Su kneels beside Ethan Zhou and cuts the clothing away from his skin, bit by bit. Outside, the fire burns until dawn before it begins to die down.
strings.舱门被一脚踹开，零下六十多度的冷风灌了进来。所有人趴在门口，大口大口地喘气。: The door is kicked open and minus-sixty air pours in. Everyone lies at the doorway, gulping it down.
strings.花油预热，试着发动它: Spend fuel on preheating and try to start it
strings.苏敏一层一层地清创、上药、包扎，整整干了三个钟头。周宇咬着毛巾，一声没吭。: Monica Su debrides, dresses and bandages, layer after layer, for three solid hours. Ethan Zhou bites the towel and never makes a sound.
strings.苏敏按住她的胳膊，把针扎了进去。唐悦挣扎了几下，慢慢安静了。: Monica Su holds her arm down and puts the needle in. Yvonne Tang struggles a few times, then slowly goes quiet.
strings.苏敏没有再说什么，只是把止痛药一片一片掰开，喂他喝了下去。: Monica Su says nothing more. She just breaks the painkillers apart one by one and feeds them to him.
strings.苏敏的急救包里只有这一个疗程。: There is only one course of it in Monica Su's kit.
strings.苏敏给周宇做了全面检查：两条胳膊、前胸和后背都是烧伤，有的地方发白发硬，面积至少: Monica Su examines Ethan Zhou thoroughly: burns on both arms, his chest and his back, some of it white and leathery, at least a third of his body surface. She says the dressings have to be changed and fluids replaced every day, or infection in the wound will finish him. But the burn dressings in the container are enough for only a few changes.
strings.药打完了，烧退了一天，又起来了。脚上的黑色还在往上爬。: The drugs run out; the fever drops for a day and comes back. The black is still creeping upward.
strings.药柜里一盒没被烧到的头孢: A box of cephalosporin in the medicine cabinet that the fire did not reach
strings.药留给更有希望的人，巴特尔只能硬扛: Save the drugs for someone with better odds; Baatar just has to take it
strings.袋子被拿走了。姜涛盯着那个空位置看了很久，说：“那俺明天再给他做。”: The bag is taken away. Tommy Jiang stares at the empty place for a long time and says, "Then I'll cook him some more tomorrow."
strings.装电话的那个包裹也找到了，就挂在一根标志杆上。: The bundle with the phone turned up too, hanging on a marker pole.
strings.装着三年数据的笔记本电脑: The laptop with three years of data on it
strings.裹起来，等它自己好: Wrap it up and let it heal on its own
strings.要两个人举镜子、递器械；敷料 −2、抗生素 −1。刀口在自己身上，手不能抖: Takes two people to hold the mirror and pass instruments; dressings −2, antibiotics −1. The incision is in your own body, and your hands cannot shake
strings.要占用很久的电台和电，可他也许能听见妈妈的声音: Ties up the radio and the power for a long time, but he might hear his mother's voice
strings.要去让她自己去: If she wants to go, she goes alone
strings.要在废墟里干好几个钟头；可他不该一个人留在那儿: Hours of work in the ruins; but he should not be left there alone
strings.要在废墟里待好几个钟头；去的人可能被砸伤、冻伤: Hours in the ruins; whoever goes may be crushed or frostbitten
strings.要在零下六十多度的外面站上一阵；也许能让他放下: Means standing outside at minus sixty for a while; it might let him put it down
strings.要求他们马上派飞机，不管天气: Demand they send a plane now, weather or not
strings.让他省点力气，好好睡一觉: Save his strength and let him sleep properly
strings.让最懂机器的人马上拆开修: Have whoever knows machines best take it apart now
strings.让苏敏给他吃安眠药，先让他睡几个整觉: Have Monica Su give him sleeping pills and let him sleep a few full nights first
strings.让苏敏给她打一针镇静剂: Have Monica Su give her a sedative
strings.该烧就烧，人冻坏了什么都干不了: Burn what needs burning. A frozen man cannot do anything
strings.说一不二，习惯掌控局面；在冰上干了二十年，最看重纪律；嘴硬，从不在人前示弱；把每: Uncompromising, used to holding the situation in his hands; twenty years on the ice and discipline is what he values most; tough-talking, never shows weakness in front of anyone; treats every crew member as one of his soldiers, and is more afraid of responsibility than anyone.
strings.说俄语，夹着几个英语单词，爱说“Ничего（没事）”“Нормально（还行: Speaks Russian with a few English words mixed in, fond of saying "Ничего" and "Нормально"; Evan Ho's scraps of English are the only translation in the container.
strings.说出来很难听——可出去挖油的人更需要热量: It sounds ugly to say it — but the people digging fuel outside need the calories more
strings.说出来，也许还能保住大家的信任: Say it, and it may still hold everyone's trust together
strings.说到第二个钟头，姜涛把刀放在了地上：“俺就是想让师父吃口热的。”: In the second hour Tommy Jiang puts the knife down on the floor: "I just wanted Master to eat something hot."
strings.说实话，但请他们再等几个钟头看看: Tell the truth, but ask them to wait a few more hours and see
strings.说实话：他多半撑不到飞机来: Tell the truth: he most likely will not last until the plane comes
strings.说实话：她没通过，是你改的结论: Tell the truth: she failed, and you changed the result
strings.说话不紧不慢，用词准确，偶尔带一点医生的冷幽默。: Speaks unhurriedly, precise with words, with an occasional flash of a doctor's dry humor.
strings.说话很轻，常常说到一半停下来，爱说“对不起”“我可以的”。: Speaks very quietly, often stops halfway through a sentence, fond of saying "Sorry" and "I can do it."
strings.请他歇一晚，明天就把伤得最重的人拉回东方站: Let him rest a night, and tomorrow take the worst hurt back to Vostok
strings.请他进舱，他带来的东西大家一起用: Ask him inside and share everything he brought
strings.谁也不走，让他一个人回去: Nobody goes; he drives back alone
strings.谁也别再回去，先守住应急舱、救周宇: Nobody goes back in. Hold the container and keep Ethan Zhou alive
strings.调查报告认定：起火原因是 2 号发电机回油管卡箍未紧固。他被单位除了名，回了河北: The report found that the fire was caused by a loose clamp on the fuel return line of Generator No. 2. He was struck off the payroll and went home to Hebei, where he opened a farm-machinery repair shop in the town. Every clamp he tightens he tightens twice, then taps it with a wrench and listens to the sound.
strings.谢尔盖·库兹明，俄罗斯东方站的越冬机械师兼驾驶员，第七次越冬。东方站在三百多公里: Sergey Kuzmin, winter-over mechanic and driver at Russia's Vostok Station, his seventh winter. Vostok is over three hundred kilometers away, the nearest winter-over station to Xueling. He does not speak a word of Chinese and has only a few dozen words of English, so everything is done with hands and sketches. The winter of 1982, when the power station at Vostok burned to the ground, his father was on that crew.
strings.谢尔盖一进门就把一个大包往桌上一扔：罐头、黑面包、一盒俄文标签的针剂。他挨个拍了: Sergey walks in and drops a big pack on the table: cans, black bread, a box of ampoules with Russian labels. He goes down the line patting everyone on the shoulder, and stands a long time at the wounded man's bunk before taking off his hat.
strings.谢尔盖叼着一根没点的烟，一个下午就把炉子焊好了。滴油炉烧起来呼呼作响，舱里头一回: Sergey works with an unlit cigarette in his mouth and has the stove welded together by evening. The drip stove roars, and for the first time the container is warm enough to take your gloves off.
strings.谢尔盖在一块纸箱板上画了半天：一个空油桶，底下接一根细油管，柴油一滴一滴往里滴，: Sergey spends half a day drawing on a piece of cardboard: an empty fuel drum, a thin fuel line off the bottom, diesel dripping in drop by drop, a chimney going up through the roof. He points at himself, writes "1982," and draws a ball of fire — the year the power station at Vostok burned, and his father and the others survived the winter on stoves like this one. But to fit it, someone has to cut a hole in the roof of the container.
strings.谢尔盖带来的那个铝壶里，装的是东方站的医用酒精——兑上雪水，就是俄国越冬队员过节: The aluminum flask Sergey brought holds Vostok's medical alcohol — cut with snowmelt, it is the "spirt" Russian winter-over crews drink on holidays. Tonight is clear and still, minus seventy; someone unscrews the cap: one mouthful each to warm up?
strings.谢尔盖把一张地图摊在桌上，用铅笔从雪岭站画了一条线到东方站，又指指自己、指指外面: Sergey spreads a map on the table and draws a pencil line from Xueling to Vostok, then points at himself, then at the sledge cabin outside: he has to go back — he is the only mechanic Vostok has this winter, and he has only enough fuel for the return. The sledge cabin can take one wounded man; if everyone squeezes in, it might just fit them all.
strings.谢尔盖把纸箱板揉成一团，嘟囔了一句俄语。没人听得懂，可谁都听得出是什么意思。: Sergey crumples the cardboard and mutters something in Russian. Nobody understands the words, and everybody understands the meaning.
strings.谢尔盖的车灯在黑暗里越来越小，最后只剩下一个红点。: Sergey's tail lights shrink into the dark until there is nothing left but a red point.
Sergey looks at them for a long time, shrugs, rolls both drums of fuel in through the door, and mutters, "Ничего." — It's nothing. But that night he sat alone in the sledge cabin until dawn.
strings.谢尔盖看了看伤员，点了点头，倒头就在雪橇屋里睡着了，鼾声隔着两层铁皮都听得见。: Sergey looks at the wounded man, nods, and is asleep in the sledge cabin a minute later, snoring loudly enough to carry through two sheets of steel.
strings.谢尔盖跟每个人都握了手，把剩下的半包茶叶留在了桌上。: Sergey shakes hands with everyone and leaves half a packet of tea on the table.
strings.负责气象观测和全站通信，是队里唯一摆弄得了短波电台的人。火灾时他正好在外面的观测: Responsible for weather observations and all station communications, and the only man on the crew who can make a shortwave radio behave. During the fire he happened to be outside at the observation field, in full polar gear. His laptop never leaves his side.
strings.起动机冒了一股青烟，烧了。只好把油箱里的油抽出来。: The starter motor puts out a puff of blue smoke and burns out. The fuel has to be siphoned out of the tank instead.
strings.趁火还没烧过去，去冷库和医务室抢东西: Get into the freezer and the infirmary before the fire reaches them
strings.越冬的人管极夜里的失眠叫“大眼睛”：躺下好几个钟头，眼睛就是闭不上；醒着的时候，: Winter-over crews call polar-night insomnia "the big eyes": you lie down for hours and the eyes simply will not close; awake, the mind feels wrapped in fog.
strings.车库挖开了。雪地车的油箱里还有八九十升柴油，可在零下六十度，发动机冻得像一块铁。: The garage is dug open. There are eighty or ninety L of diesel left in the snow tractor's tank, but at minus sixty the engine is a block of iron. Someone who knows machines says: point the heater at the oil pan for half a day and it might catch — and if it does, the fuel cache six kilometers out and the runway packing no longer have to be done on foot.
strings.车库没被火烧到，可大门被一人多高的吹雪埋住了。里面有雪地车、工具和蓄电池。重体力: The garage escaped the fire, but its doors are buried under blowing snow taller than a man. Inside are the snow tractor, tools and batteries. Heavy work.
strings.车库的门终于撬开了一条缝。手电光里，雪地车静静地停在那里，像一头冬眠的野兽。工具: The garage door finally gives enough to open a gap. In the torchlight the snow tractor sits waiting, quiet as a hibernating animal. Everything on the tool wall is still there, and two batteries as well.
strings.车库离主楼远，没被火烧到，可大门被一人多高的吹雪埋住了。里面有雪地车、工具和蓄电: The garage is far from the main building and escaped the fire, but its doors are buried under blowing snow taller than a man. Inside are the snow tractor, tools and batteries.
strings.这是你手里的一张牌: This is a card in your hand
strings.远征跑道油料点: Expedition to the runway fuel cache
strings.通信室和发电机房的废墟: Ruins of the radio room and generator room
strings.通信室和机房废墟里还值得拆的东西。: What is still worth stripping from the ruins of the radio room and the generator room.
strings.通信室和电台都烧没了，外面没有人知道这里出了事。下一架飞机要到九月底才会来。暖风: The radio room and the radios burned with everything else, and nobody outside knows anything has happened here. The next plane is not due until the end of September. There are only forty-odd liters of diesel left in the heater's tank: when it stops, this steel box becomes a freezer.
strings.那个卡箍的事，他到最后也没跟周宇说。每年周宇过生日，他都揣着两瓶衡水老白干坐火车: He never told Ethan Zhou about the clamp, not to the end. Every year on Ethan Zhou's birthday he takes the train to Chengdu with two bottles of Hengshui Laobaigan, and the two of them drink until midnight and neither mentions that night.
strings.那几分钟的事传遍了整个考察队。他后来去了一个海边城市的气象台，专值夜班，很少跟人: Those few minutes became known across the whole expedition. He later took a job at a weather station in a coastal city, working nights on purpose, rarely speaking to anyone. Every time the building runs a fire drill, he is the first one out the door when the bell goes.
strings.那天夜里把她从黑暗里背回来的人，她每年都会寄去一张明信片，上面只写日期和天气。她: The man who carried her back out of the dark that night gets a postcard from her every year, with nothing on it but the date and the weather. She lost two toes and limps a little when she walks fast, but she has since run a half marathon.
strings.郑国栋把 {actor} 叫到暖风机后面，压着嗓子问：“越冬前的心理评估是你签的: Graham Zheng calls {actor} behind the heater and asks in a low voice: "Yours is the signature on the pre-winter psychological evaluation. Yvonne Tang is like this, and you knew nothing?"
strings.钢锯卡在了骨头里，血怎么也止不住。{actor} 的手一直在抖。: The hacksaw jams in the bone and the bleeding will not stop. {actor}'s hands keep shaking.
strings.钢锯在暖风机的出风口上烤了三遍。巴特尔让人把舱门开了一条缝：“别让大家闻着这股味: The hacksaw is held over the heater vent three times to sterilize it. Baatar has them crack the door: "Don't make everyone eat with that smell in here."
strings.阑尾是切下来了，可已经化了脓。刀口缝上的第二天，{actor} 又烧了起来。: The appendix comes out, but it had already gone to pus. The day after the incision is closed, {actor}'s fever comes back.
strings.陪一个人坐一会儿，听他说说家里、说说出去以后想干什么。在极夜里，这比什么药都管用: Sit with someone for a while and let them talk about home, about what they want to do when they get out. In the polar night that works better than any drug.
strings.陪他去杨师傅的坟前，让他把话说完: Go with him to Chef Yang's grave and let him finish what he has to say
strings.雪地车司机兼油料员: Snow tractor driver and fuel handler
strings.雪地车在冰盖上一刻不停地开了三天三夜，谢尔盖和会开车的人轮着睡。雪橇屋里的炉子一: The snow tractor runs for three days and nights without stopping, Sergey and whoever else can drive sleeping in turns. The stove in the sledge cabin never goes out.
strings.雪地车的驾驶室有暖风，只有装卸油桶的时候要下车。一趟要烧掉 6 升柴油，能拉回两: The snow tractor's cab has heat, and you only get out to load and unload drums. One run burns 6 L of diesel and brings back two drums of fuel.
strings.雪橇在半路翻进了雪沟，油桶没能拖回来: The sledge tips into a snow gully halfway there, and the drums never make it back
strings.雪橇屋的炉子半路灭过一次。等谢尔盖发现，巴特尔已经叫不醒了。: The stove in the sledge cabin went out once on the way. By the time Sergey noticed, Baatar could not be woken.
strings.雪橇飞机在极夜里落在了你们亲手压出来的跑道上。活下来的人是：{survivors: The ski-plane came down in the polar night on the runway you packed with your own hands. The people who lived: {survivors}. Left out on the ice: {dead}, and Chef Yang, who never made it out of the fire. Back home the accident inquiry asked everyone a great many questions. Some of them had no answer.
strings.零下六十八度，太阳要到八月才会升起。发电机房烧成了空壳，应急舱里的柴油只够暖风机: Minus sixty-eight, and the sun will not rise until August. The generator room is a burned-out shell, and the diesel in the container is enough to run the heater for three more days.
strings.零下六十多度里干几个钟头，人人都可能冻伤；挖出来多少全凭运气: Hours of work at minus sixty and anyone can get frostbite; how much comes out of the snow is pure luck
strings.零下六十多度，几分钟的事。规矩是规矩——可姜涛会怎么样？: At minus sixty it takes minutes. The rules are the rules — but what will it do to Tommy Jiang?
strings.零下六十多度，她每多待一分钟就少一分活路；去找的人也会冻伤: At minus sixty, every minute she stays out is a minute less of a life; whoever goes after her will get frostbite too
strings.靴房里一套没烧坏的极地连体服，拿回去给了穿得最单薄的人: An unburned polar one-piece suit from the boot room, carried back for whoever is dressed thinnest
strings.预热要烧掉 15 升柴油；打着了，以后跑油料点和压跑道都能开车: Preheating costs 15 L of diesel; get it started and every run to the fuel cache and every pass over the runway can be done on wheels
strings.风停了。头顶的极光像一条绿色的河，在星空里慢慢流动，把整片冰原照得发亮。: The wind stops. Overhead the aurora runs like a green river, drifting across the stars, bright enough to light the whole ice sheet.
strings.风卷着雪，把舱门和暖风机的排气管埋了大半。不清出来，门就推不开，废气也会倒灌。推: Wind-driven snow has buried the door and most of the heater's exhaust. Clear it or the door will not open and the fumes will back up. Someone has to be sent out to dig.
strings.飞机今天不会来，但没有人拿机组的命冒险: The plane will not come today, and nobody gambled with the crew's lives
strings.飞机又来了。这一次它压低高度，在你们的火光上空盘旋了两圈，几个挂着降落伞的包裹从: The plane comes again. This time it comes in low, circles twice over your fires, and several parachutes fall from the belly of the aircraft, drifting down toward the dark a kilometer away — minus sixty, no road, nothing but headlamps.
strings.飞机可能今天就来——也可能在跑道上空找不到地面，白跑一趟: The plane may come today — or it may find nothing under it over the runway and make the trip for nothing
strings.飞机在云里转了两圈，找不到跑道，掉头飞回了海岸。机长在电台里只说了一句：“下次，: The plane circles twice in cloud, cannot find the runway, and turns back for the coast. The pilot says one thing on the radio: "Next time, give us real numbers."
strings.飞机在跑道上只停了三十八分钟。一个不少——伤得最重的人被裹在两个睡袋里抬上了飞机: The plane is on the ground for thirty-eight minutes. Not one missing — the worst hurt is carried aboard wrapped in two sleeping bags, and someone holds his hand the whole way. As it climbs out, someone looks down through a porthole: the little window of the emergency container is still lit, a single star on the ice sheet. The evacuation later went into the polar safety textbooks. Those who came home alive: {survivors}.
strings.飞机落地的时候，来接的人只找到了 {survivors}。机组的人在应急舱里站了: When the plane landed, the people who came out to meet it found only {survivors}. The crew stood a long time in the emergency container and said nothing. {dead} stayed behind on the ice sheet — nobody will come back for them until next summer.
strings.饼干盒被拿出了舱门。姜涛没有哭，只是从那天起，再也不在饭桌上说话了。: The biscuit tin is carried out of the container. Tommy Jiang does not cry; he simply never speaks at the table again.
strings.饼干盒被放回了暖风机旁边最暖和的角落。那天晚上，好几个人都偷偷爬起来，去看了它一: The biscuit tin goes back to the warmest corner, beside the heater. That night several of them quietly got up to take a look at it.
strings.马上打开舱门通风，把人都拖到门口: Open the door now to air it out and drag everyone to the doorway
strings.（他咬着毛巾，一声不吭，额头上的汗把枕头洇湿了一大片。）: (He bites down on the towel and makes no sound; the sweat on his forehead soaks a wide patch of the pillow.)
strings.（他哼起一段长调，没人听得懂词，舱里一下子安静了。）: (He hums a long song, the words nobody understands, and the container goes quiet.)
strings.（他指着暖风机的排气管，皱着眉头比划：“Угарный газ!”——一氧化碳。: (He points at the heater's exhaust, frowning, and mouths: "Угарный газ!" — carbon monoxide.)
